You'll investigate new attack surfaces, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems, and build systems that help detect threats and improve vulnerability advisories.<br>This is a full-stack role: you'll take an idea from the first research question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. Artificial intelligence (AI) is central to how we work. You'll use AI tools daily and build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection.<br><br>What you'll do</div> <ul> <li>Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.</li> <li>Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.</li> <li>Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.</li> <li>Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.</li> <li>Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.</li> <li>Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.</li> <li>Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.</li> </ul> <div>What you'll bring</div> <ul> <li>Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with an understanding of package ecosystems and software supply chain attacks.</li> <li>Both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model (LLM) application programming interfaces (APIs) or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent software development kits (SDKs).</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices, including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and writing maintainable code.</li> <li>Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.</li> <li>The ability to map attack vectors, explain trade-offs, and use data to move experiments forward, balancing quality, speed, and customer outcomes.</li> <li>Clear writing for engineers and a general audience, and keeping up with security and AI industry trends.</li> <li>Helpful, but not required: Google Cloud Platform (GCP); Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entries or published findings; research on AI agents, LLM applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; blogs, talks, or open source security tools; Terraform or OpenTofu; databases or data pipelines at scale; reverse engineering.</li> <li>You don't need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing (SAST) engines. A high-level understanding is enough.</li> </ul> <div>About the team<br>We're the Threat Research group. title: Operations Manager (m/f/d)

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Why At Dotmatics </strong></p> <p>At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Instruments speak different languages, workflows are hard to change, and the data that comes off the line rarely arrives ready for analysis or AI. </p> <p>We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. Lab Orchestration and automation are core to our Molecule to Market story, and they connect directly to the strengths of Siemens in industrial automation. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.</p> <p>This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with lab automation leaders at pharma, biotech, CDMOs, and research institutes across the UK and Europe, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the lab automation market with confidence and one consistent story. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to lab automation buyers, and turn that into real software adoption.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the market strategy for Luma in lab automation, including workflow orchestration, scheduling, instrument integration, data capture, and autonomous lab concepts</li> <li>Define target segments, buyer personas, and priority description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Architect control systems and develop PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) software, primarily on Beckhoff platforms. Commission and validate manufacturing equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and predictable operation. Partner with mechanical, process, and manufacturing engineers to translate production requirements into robust, well-documented automation solutions. Architect control system architecture and electrical schematics for new equipment, including sensor/actuator selection and panel layout coordination with electrical designers. Set up and tune servo drives and VFDs (Variable Frequency Drives) for precision motion control on winding, handling, and assembly equipment. Design intuitive HMI (Human-Machine Interface)/SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) screens for operator use and troubleshooting. Commission new equipment end-to-end: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test)/SAT (Site Acceptance Test), installation, integration, and initial process validation. Use hand tools and diagnostic instruments (multimeters, oscilloscopes, etc.) for hands-on electrical troubleshooting during build and commissioning. Implement control-reliable safety systems in line with relevant machine safety and electrical standards. Document control architecture, code, and equipment operation to support handover and future sustaining work. Collaborate with manufacturing, mechanical, and process engineers to ensure controls solutions match the realities of magnet coil production. Able to use common hand tools and diagnostic instruments such as multimeters. Proficiency in field network topology, both theory and practical applications. 2–5 years of experience in controls engineering for manufacturing or automation equipment, ideally on electromechanical or precision systems. Experience commissioning servo drives/VFDs and integrating sensors, actuators, and safety devices. Familiarity with HMI/SCADA platforms (TwinCAT HMI, WinCC, Ignition, or similar). Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Nice to have: Experience with CAD (Computer-Aided Design) electrical drafting tools (e.g., AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN). Scripting experience (Python, SQL) for data acquisition or MES (Manufacturing Execution System)/database integration. Machine vision experience. Greenfield or startup equipment commissioning experience. Working knowledge of relevant electrical and machine safety standards (e.g., EN (European Norm) 60204-1, IEC 61439, ISO (International Organization for Standardization) 13849). Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up. Talk to users directly . Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog. Do your own data work . You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself. Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan . Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order. Design and run tests . You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists. You've moved teams you don't manage . Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job. You write and speak clearly. This is the strongest single signal we look for, because in a cross-team role, clear communication is most of how work actually moves. AI is already part of how you work , and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers English fluency. Demo Excellence Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product. Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect. Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization. Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly. Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines. Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed. title: Founder Associate (Berlin)
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. You get real ownership of business functions, with broad exposure across the company, from strategy to execution. We run our business functions with defined areas of ownership: Growth, Sales & Enablement, Marketing & Community, and People Ops. You pick up ownership across these areas based on what the company needs and where you're strongest, and you go deep where you have the most impact. Everything we do is AI-first, so you'll spend less time on the grunt work and more time building the systems that make it obsolete. Core Areas of Impact Below are examples of what you could own: Growth Leads that reach Prior Labs get qualified, enriched, scored, and routed automatically. You own that engine, make it better, and find the next channel. Automate call prep: short briefings so no one walks into a call cold Own decks, case studies, battle cards, and demo assets Keep POCs on track: milestones, follow-ups, next steps Turn closed deals into reference stories and case studies Ops & Automation We think most internal work can be automated with today's AI, and your job is to do it. Help open our new offices and set up new countries Own onboarding end to end, from signed contract to a solid first week Take clunky people processes, redesign it, ship it Make our HRIS the single source of truth, with automations doing the boring parts Run the operational side of hiring: scheduling, candidate communication, interview logistics What We're Looking For You're a resourceful, adaptable, and self-driven builder who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment. We're looking for someone with the potential to grow into a future leader of the company. title: Graduate Program (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com . We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. Every day, millions of travelers book buses, trains, ferries and transfers through platforms they know, and many of those bookings run on Distribusion. We connect hundreds of carriers with the world’s leading travel retailers, making ground transport as easy to book as a flight. We’re looking for ambitious graduates who want real responsibility from day one. As part of our Graduate Program, you’ll join one of our core teams as an Analyst or Engineer, work on live products used across the globe, and learn alongside people who are building the infrastructure of ground travel. Workplace: Berlin & Remote or willing to relocate to Berlin. Where you could make your mark Product: Analyst roles Search Engine & Booking Platform: Build the core engine that returns fast, scalable search results and handles thousands of booking requests per second. Supply & Integrations: Connect hundreds of external carrier APIs and help build robust, fault‑tolerant infrastructure that keeps bookings flowing. E‑commerce: Shape the booking engines, payment flows and user journeys that let travelers search, book, pay for and manage trips. Your work directly moves conversion and retention for a global audience across many markets, currencies and languages. Connectivity: Build enterprise‑grade integrations with external systems like Salesforce, SAP, CRMs and government authorities, with a strong focus on automation and innovation. Tech: Engineer roles Demand Engineering: Work on the heart of our platform: the search and booking engine that lets the world’s biggest travel retailers sell bus and rail tickets through a single API, and the schedule system behind hundreds of thousands of daily departures used by hundreds of operators. Build high‑throughput microservices, help modernize our core search engine, and shape the product, not just the code. Content Engineering: Build the pipelines that keep global travel data accurate and up to date. Automate how we ingest stations, prices and schedule changes in real time, and apply AI to keep millions of data points reliable at scale. Partnerships Regional Partnerships: Work hands‑on with bus, rail, ferry and transfer operators and leading travel retailers in your region, guiding them from first integration to growing their bookings across our global network. Corporate Partnerships: Bring ground transport into business travel by working with travel management companies, corporate travel agencies and booking tools, from technical onboarding to growing the partnership. Performance & Growth: Dig into partner data, spot opportunities, and build the processes and automation that help us scale. Who you are: STEM or tech-related academic background - You’re a recent (or soon-to-be) graduate in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Business/Information Systems, or a similar field. Analytical mindset & problem-solving - You love digging into complex problems, understanding how things work, and turning ambiguity into clear, structured solutions. Technical curiosity: You have a basic understanding of APIs, systems or digital products (through studies, internships or projects), and you’re excited to build with AI, whether that’s experimenting with new tools, prototyping ideas or putting AI to work on real problems in a high‑scale environment. Strong communication - You can explain ideas clearly, whether talking to engineers, product managers, or business teams — and you enjoy bridging technical and non-technical worlds. Collaborative & cross-functional - You like working with diverse teams and feel comfortable contributing to group projects, Agile teamwork, and shared problem-solving. Fast learner & adaptable - You thrive in dynamic environments, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and stay resilient when things change or are not fully defined. Ownership & ambition - You’re eager to take responsibility early, bring ideas to the table, and help shape processes that improve how products get delivered. What you can expect: Global reach & real-world impact - You help build software that enables travel for millions of people globally; your work supports real journeys across countries and continents, and makes transportation more accessible. Cutting-edge tech in a high‑scale environment - From microservices and real-time search to AI-based content automation and cloud infrastructure, you’ll gain hands-on experience with many modern technologies and complex systems. Fast growth & startup energy - Distribusion is rapidly expanding globally (70+ countries, hundreds of carriers/retailers), backed by strong funding — you’ll have the opportunity to take real ownership early, learn fast, and grow with the company. Variety: you can pick what excites you - Whether you like backend APIs, front‑end booking flows, data & analytics or product. There are many teams and disciplines where you can start, explore and specialise. Meaningful mission — mobility & sustainability - By enabling efficient ground transportation (bus, rail, ferry) globally, Distribusion contributes to more sustainable travel alternatives to private cars or flights. Global partnerships & industry exposure - You’ll collaborate with some of the biggest names in travel technology and national transportation, working directly with partners like Booking.com , Google Maps, Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF. International team & inspiring culture - You’ll join a diverse, mission-driven team where talented people support, challenge, and learn from one another every day, a place to grow fast and make a real impact. To qualify for the Graduate Programme , you should: Finish or about to finish your studies by end of 2026. Be available to begin full-time employment , in line with local labor laws and visa regulations. Our hiring process for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Masha Marynova. For any queries, please contact your Talent Partner at ( Do you want to work in an advanced tech environment and have an impact on millions of travellers around the globe? Come join us! title: Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title:</strong> Senior Program Manager, Data Center Delivery & Site Readiness</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Austin, TX</li> <li>San Francisco, CA</li> <li>New York, NY</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Program Manager to own data center delivery and the sourcing work that gets each site ready to operate. You'll take projects from vendor selection and contract negotiation through construction, infrastructure deployment, commissioning, and handover to operations.</p> <p>This role combines technical program management with hands-on commercial execution. You'll work with engineering, construction, procurement, and operations teams to ensure facilities, equipment, and site services are ready when they're needed, with clear accountability for schedule, cost, and quality.</p> <h1>What you'll do</h1> <h2>Deliver data centers</h2> <ul> <li>Represent Cloudflare across new builds and expansions, managing data center providers, general contractors, design consultants, commissioning agents, and compute integration partners.</li> <li>Coordinate mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) installation, white space fit-out, rack-level power, structured cabling, equipment staging and validation, and commissioning through operational acceptance.</li> <li>Maintain a delivery schedule that connects construction milestones, equipment arrivals, service activation, and deployment dependencies. Resolve field issues and drive recovery plans when commitments slip.</li> <li>Assess vendor and partner readiness before deployment, and coordinate handover with operations so acceptance criteria, documentation, and support responsibilities are clear.</li> </ul> <h2>Source site services and manage contracts</h2> <ul> <li>Own sourcing for the services each site needs to open and operate, including temporary power and water, security, waste management, and facilities support.</li> <li>Translate construction and operational requirements into scopes of work, supplier selections, and service start dates. Identify gaps early enough to prevent delays to site work.</li> <li>Negotiate regional and multi-site agreements, rate cards, service-level commitments, and change orders that new sites can use without restarting procurement.</li> <li>Hold suppliers accountable for delivery, service quality, and commercial commitments, coordinating utility and service-provider dependencies with construction and operations.</li> </ul> <h2>Manage the portfolio</h2> <ul> <li>Track budgets, forecasts, scope changes, and risks across concurrent projects. Give leadership concise updates on progress, tradeoffs, and decisions needed.</li> <li>Build repeatable site-readiness and delivery playbooks, including sourcing checklists, vendor qualification, milestone tracking, and handover requirements. Apply lessons from each build to the next.</li> <li>Ensure deployment activities meet applicable codes, safety standards, and security requirements in partnership with the responsible technical teams.</li> </ul> <h1>What you'll bring</h1> <ul> <li>7+ years in technical program management, construction management, or infrastructure delivery, including at least 5 years working on data center or high-density infrastructure projects.</li> <li>Direct experience managing data center providers or general contractors on behalf of an owner, including contract administration, schedule oversight, and scope changes.</li> <li>Hands-on sourcing experience for site services or indirect categories in multi-site industrial environments, including standing up services for a new site.</li> <li>Experience negotiating supplier agreements and rate cards across locations, with a practical understanding of how procurement lead times affect construction and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data center MEP systems, white space delivery, structured cabling, rack-level power distribution, and compute staging and integration.</li> <li>Experience managing substantial infrastructure budgets and competing dependencies across multiple projects.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical delivery issues and commercial tradeoffs to senior leadership.</li> <li>A bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, architecture, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred experience</h1> <ul> <li>High-density GPU deployments and liquid cooling systems.</li> <li>Fast-track or modular data center construction.</li> <li>Utility coordination, security services contracting, and facilities management agreements.</li> <li>PMP or an equivalent project management credential.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Initiativbewerbung (m/w/d) – Bregenz, Wien, München, Düsseldorf
description: Wofür wir stehen: Du passt zu uns. Aber die passende Stelle fehlt noch? Dann lass uns trotzdem kennenlernen! Alles ist BETA. Deshalb hinterfragen wir Bestehendes, denken weiter und gestalten Veränderung aktiv mit. Wir unterstützen B2B-Unternehmen dabei, ihre Go-to-Market-Strategien und -Prozesse neu zu denken, Wachstum zu beschleunigen und digitale Geschäftsmodelle erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dafür verbinden wir Consulting, kreative Expertise, Technologie, Data und AI – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Du findest dich in unseren aktuellen Stellenangeboten nicht wieder, hast aber das Gefühl, dass wir gut zusammenpassen könnten? Dann zeig uns, was du mitbringst und wo du bei uns etwas bewegen möchtest. Deine Rolle: Wir verbinden unterschiedliche Perspektiven und Kompetenzen, um B2B-Unternehmen erfolgreicher zu machen. Vielleicht liegt deine Stärke in einem dieser Bereiche: Go-to-Market Consulting: Du gestaltest, wie Unternehmen ihre Märkte bearbeiten, Kunden gewinnen und nachhaltig wachsen – von Sales & Marketing über Revenue Operations und CRM bis zur kommerziellen Transformation. Platform Consulting: Du verbindest Business-Anforderungen, Prozesse und Technologie zu tragfähigen digitalen Lösungen und begleitest komplexe Transformationsprojekte. Creative Experience: Du entwickelst Markenauftritte, digitale Erlebnisse und nutzerzentrierte Lösungen, die Menschen überzeugen und Business-Ziele unterstützen. Platform Development: Du konzipierst und entwickelst skalierbare digitale Plattformen, integrierst Systeme und bringst innovative Technologien in den produktiven Einsatz. Data & AI: Du machst Daten nutzbar, entwickelst intelligente Lösungen und setzt AI und Automatisierung ein, um Prozesse und Entscheidungen nachhaltig zu verbessern. People, Finance, IT & Operations: Du sorgst hinter den Kulissen dafür, dass wir erfolgreich sind und weiter wachsen können – von People & Culture über Finance & Controlling bis hin zu interner IT und operativen Prozessen. Dein Schwerpunkt ist nicht dabei? Kein Problem. Wir sind neugierig, welche Expertise und Perspektive du bei uns einbringen möchtest. Damit kannst Du punkten: Uns ist nicht nur wichtig, was du kannst, sondern auch, wie du denkst, handelst und mit anderen zusammenarbeitest. Du denkst vom Kunden aus. Du willst Herausforderungen wirklich verstehen und Lösungen schaffen, die nachhaltig Mehrwert bringen. Du hast Ambition. Du setzt hohe Maßstäbe an deine Arbeit, entwickelst deine Expertise kontinuierlich weiter und willst gemeinsam mit anderen wachsen. Du gestaltest eigenständig. Du nutzt Freiräume, bringst Ideen ein und machst aus Möglichkeiten konkrete Ergebnisse. Du übernimmst Verantwortung. Du handelst proaktiv, triffst Entscheidungen und bleibst dran – auch wenn es schwierig wird. Du bist offen für Neues. Du hinterfragst Bestehendes, gibst und nutzt Feedback und setzt dich aktiv mit neuen Technologien und AI auseinander. Du schätzt unterschiedliche Perspektiven. Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen, teilst dein Wissen und weißt, dass die besten Lösungen selten allein entstehen. Du musst nicht in allem perfekt sein. Entscheidend ist, dass du Lust hast, dich weiterzuentwickeln, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Was wir von Dir benötigen: Mission started? Dann brauchen wir nur noch ein paar Dinge von dir: Deinen CV , damit wir einen ersten Eindruck von deinem bisherigen Weg und deiner Expertise bekommen. Deinen Wunschbereich: Erzähl uns kurz, welche Themen, Aufgaben oder Rollen dich bei uns interessieren und wo du deine Stärken einbringen möchtest. Dein gewünschtes Arbeitsmodell: Suchst du eine Vollzeit- oder Teilzeitrolle? Gibt es etwas, das wir bei der Zusammenarbeit berücksichtigen sollten? Deinen möglichen Starttermin beziehungsweise deine Kündigungsfrist. Deine Gehaltsvorstellung , damit wir frühzeitig prüfen können, ob unsere Vorstellungen zusammenpassen. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Uns interessiert vor allem, wer du bist, was dich antreibt und was du gemeinsam mit uns gestalten möchtest. Warum wir? Anspruchsvolle Projekte, Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, und jede Menge Raum für deine Entwicklung. Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeit, fachlich zu wachsen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und deinen Arbeitsalltag so zu gestalten, dass er zu dir passt. Spannende Projekte mit Impact: Arbeite an innovativen, abwechslungsreichen Herausforderungen für B2B-Unternehmen. Mit steiler Lernkurve, neuen Technologien und der Möglichkeit, echten Fortschritt mitzugestalten. Keep growing: Nutze dein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget für Workshops, Zertifizierungen oder Coachings. Klare Karrierepfade geben dir Orientierung für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung – auch ohne klassische Führungslaufbahn. Teamspirit pur: Freu dich auf Kolleg:innen mit unterschiedlichen Expertisen, echtem Zusammenhalt, gegenseitiger Unterstützung und einer guten Portion Humor. Austausch auf Augenhöhe: Flache Hierarchien, transparente Strukturen und eine gelebte Open-Door-Mentalität sorgen dafür, dass Ideen gehört und Wissen geteilt werden. Open Vacation Policy: Neben deinen gesetzlichen Urlaubstagen kannst du mit unserer „Above & Beyond“-Regelung zusätzliche freie Tage nehmen. Work from anywhere: Ob Homeoffice oder temporär im Ausland – gestalte deinen Arbeitsort flexibel. Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Modelle: Ein großer Gleitzeitrahmen und unterschiedliche Beschäftigungsmodelle – von Vollzeit bis Teilzeit, dauerhaft oder zeitlich begrenzt. Gemeinsam finden wir eine Lösung, die zu deinem Leben und unserer Zusammenarbeit passt. Top-Equipment: Hochwertige Hardware, die du weitgehend selbst auswählen kannst. Mobility & Events: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem Zuschuss für dein Öffi- oder Deutschlandticket und sorgen mit regelmäßigen Teamevents sowie Besuchen auf Messen und Conventions für gemeinsame Erlebnisse und neue Impulse. Loft-Offices: Zentral gelegen, modern und kreativ eingerichtet – mit Platz für Austausch, neue Ideen, Snacks und Drinks. Rewards: Ein Prämiensystem, das persönliche Leistungen und gemeinsame unternehmerische Erfolge honoriert. Du siehst dich bei uns? Dann mach den ersten Schritt! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung. Auch wenn wir gerade keine passende Stelle ausgeschrieben haben, schauen wir uns deine Bewerbung individuell an und prüfen, welche Möglichkeiten sich gemeinsam ergeben könnten. Alles ist BETA. title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
description: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand. That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish : from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team . Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn. This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling. What you will do Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus. Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners. Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows. Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements. Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling. Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR). What we are looking for: Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking. Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus. Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike. High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved. Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany. Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare. One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner. Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with. What success looks like After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team. After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months. After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster. Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova. How it works Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps: Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built. Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly. We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity. title: (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d)
description: At aedifion , you will actively shape the future of energy-efficient building operations. Our mission is to make existing buildings smarter, more sustainable, and easier to manage making a real contribution to CO₂ reduction. You'll join an innovative tech company that uses cutting-edge technologies like IoT, AI, and cloud solutions to enable sustainable real estate. Our culture? Open, diverse, and team-oriented. With more than 100 colleagues from various nations, we combine a wide range of expertise and perspectives to achieve big things together. Your impact in this position: As our (Senior) Revenue Operations Manager (f/m/d) , your mission is to make sure our revenue organization grows in a way that is strong, predictable and scalable. You combine data analysis with consistent process automation, and you play a key part in giving Sales more time for what actually matters, in raising forecast quality to a new level, and in building a go-to-market (GTM) structure that scales with aedifion. What you can expect: Sales enablement roadmap: Take ownership of the prioritized sales enablement roadmap and drive it forward, so that manual work in Sales goes down step by step through workflow automation. Forecast and pipeline: Define what good pipeline quality and forecast accuracy mean at aedifion, track how both develop, and turn what you see into concrete measures that make our planning more reliable. Turning data into decisions: Analyze GTM data from different sources, spot patterns and connections, and translate them into clear recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on. GTM process architecture: Design and improve the processes along the entire GTM funnel, set clear definitions and handovers between teams, and keep developing them based on your own analyses. Building agents and governance: Build and roll out AI agents for recurring steps in GTM work, establish one common standard for how AI automation is used, and keep quality and oversight across all teams. GTM tech stack: Evaluate tools against defined criteria, prepare well-founded decision papers, and shape together with our Head of Business Operations how new solutions fit into our existing tool landscape. Strategic GTM planning: Create the analytical basis for decisions on growth, market coverage and compensation, so they rest on solid data and set the right incentives for our team. At aedifion we foster an open and appreciative culture where everyone can develop freely, regardless of background, gender, age, ability or orientation. We offer a safe space for personal growth and independent work. Flexibility and openness matter to us, so that everyone can work with authenticity and enjoy what they do. We especially welcome applications from women. What you bring along: Experience: You hold a university degree and have already taken ownership in Revenue Operations with results you can point to, ideally in a scale-up or start-up environment. Automation and AI: You know process automation and AI-supported workflows from your own hands-on work, you have implemented concrete use cases yourself, and you know where they add the most value in GTM. Data analysis: You bring complex data from different sources together, see the patterns in it and turn them into recommendations that revenue leaders and the C-level can act on. CRM and BI tools: You know your way around Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and you have experience presenting data clearly with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Metabase. Stakeholder coordination: You have worked with different teams before, you know how to moderate competing requirements, communicate priorities clearly and make complex topics understandable for everyone involved. GTM expertise: You know the key metrics of a revenue organization, you understand how pipeline, forecast and stage velocity work, and you have a solid grasp of retention metrics such as NRR, renewal rate and expansion. Languages and tools: With very good German and English (C1 each) you communicate confidently across the team. Experience with Confluence or a comparable tool and with the Microsoft 365 environment rounds off your profile. Benefits Make a difference: Your work helps to reduce CO₂ emissions and make buildings more sustainable and energy-efficient. Mobile work: Organise your working day according to your needs – with flexible working hours, short core working hours and the freedom to work from our modern office in Cologne, remotely from anywhere in Germany or up to 10 days a year from other European countries. Feel-good offer: With 30 days of annual leave, you can relax and unwind, while fresh organic fruit, regional coffee, free drinks and our monthly team breakfast provide you with your daily energy boost. Further training: We support you with tailor-made training opportunities to advance your career. Tech stack: You will receive modern work equipment of your choice – whether Microsoft or Apple – as well as high-quality noise-cancelling headphones for focused work. Mobility package: Always mobile: you can choose between the Germany Ticket or a Jobrad bike – for your commute or private use. Pension provision: Subsidies for capital-forming benefits (VWL) or company pension schemes (bAV). Stay active: With our Urban Sports Club membership, you have access to a wide range of sports and fitness offers – to help you recharge and stay healthy inside and outside of work. #teamaedifion: Regular team events, working on an equal footing, actively sharing experiences and flat hierarchies promote strong teamwork and open communication within our team. Dog-friendly office: Bring your dog along – we look forward to some animal support. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development & Sales Intern (w/m/d)

title: Senior Systems Engineer, Basin Pipelines
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations | Austin, TX; Seattle, WA or London, UK</h3> <h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a massively successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization. </p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About the project</strong></h3> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-basin/">Cloudflare Basin</a> became generally available during Birthday Week 2026. We are looking to extend engineering teams working on Basin Pipelines:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Basin Pipelines ingests, transforms, and loads streaming data into Apache Iceberg or Parquet in R2</p> </li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3>Is this role a fit for you?</h3> <p>We are looking for engineers who build infrastructure software from scratch, not those who operate it. If your core expertise is configuring, managing, scaling, or writing applications on top of existing data platforms like Kafka, Flink, Spark, Databricks, or Snowflake, this role is not the right fit. We are seeking the engineers who can write the code that replaces these tools.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>As a Senior Systems Engineer focused on Cloudflare's core storage and streaming products, you will design and implement the foundational layers of our next-generation data services. We work backward from developer needs, reimagining solutions by leveraging our unique global network.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might be architecting a new globally distributed data consistency model, optimizing storage engine performance, or designing a novel API for a new data-centric product. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to JavaScript, Typescript, Rust, and C++.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Minimum 5+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying the internals of large-scale distributed systems or storage engines from scratch.</li> <li>Direct experience writing core components of a storage or streaming system.</li> <li>Proven track record of debugging, profiling, and fixing complex race conditions, split-brain scenarios, and network partition failures at the infrastructure layer.</li> <li>Deep, expert-level proficiency in Rust or C++ applied to systems programming.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Experience building time-series databases, log-structured merge-trees, or real-time stream processing engines from the ground up.</li> <li>Academic or professional contributions to distributed systems research (e.g., consensus, conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs), or database theory).</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Platform
description: Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to. This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing. Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along. Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards. Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software. Some of the challenges waiting for you You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions. Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database. Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform. Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion. Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function. A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents). Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems. Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. Culture & Growth What We Offer An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities. Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+. Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly. Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact. Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution. Flexible Work: Work from home, the office or a hybrid mix. We focus on results, not clocking hours. Time Off and Wellbeing: 30 days of vacation and an EGYM Wellpass membership. Free Public Transport: A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for travel across Germany. Team Connection: Regular team dinners, company meetups and offsite events. How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo is more than taking on a role. It's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation and growth is a shared journey. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Executive (Germany)
description: About Ping Identity: At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. The Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory focused on net new opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. We will consider applicants based in any German location, ideally near an airport or main train station for business travel. You will: Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed. You have: Significant quota-carrying experience selling enterprise software solutions. Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. Established sector-related C level contacts. Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators. Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. Eligibility to work in Germany Native/fluent German language skills Life at Ping: We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special: A company culture that empowers you to do your best work. Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone. Regular company and team bonding events. Competitive benefits and perks. Global volunteering and community initiatives Our Benefits: Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule Parental Leave Progressive Healthcare Options Retirement Programs Opportunity for Education Reimbursement Commuter Offset (Specific locations) Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self. We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) für Gebäude-Energieberatung & Sanierungskoordination
company: ENERDOMO Flensburg, Sønderborg, Glücksburg, Harrislee und Handewitt
description: Haben Sie schon länger über eine berufliche Veränderung nachgedacht? Möchten Sie ein Unternehmen als Geschäftsführer in unserem Franchise leiten und dabei eine Aufgabe übernehmen, die wirtschaftlich attraktiv ist und echten Sinn stiftet? Dann könnte diese Chance für Sie passen – insbesondere, wenn Sie aus einer dieser Regionen kommen: Flensburg Sønderborg Glücksburg Harrislee Handewitt Gebäude-Energieberatung Die Nachfrage nach Gebäude-Energieberatung steigt stark: Kunden wollen ihre Öl- und Gaskosten senken und Immobilien zukunftssicher sanieren. Gleichzeitig fehlen vielerorts Gebäude-Energieberater – das schafft hervorragende Chancen für Quereinsteiger. Ideal für Quereinsteiger Sie benötigen keine umfangreichen fachlichen Voraussetzungen, um einen gebietsgeschützten Standort aufzubauen. ENERDOMO unterstützt Sie von Anfang an – auch nach der Neueröffnung. Qualifizierung in 27 Tagen In der hybriden ENERDOMO Akademie (Königstein/Frankfurt & Online) erhalten Quereinsteiger ein strukturiertes Einarbeitungs- und Qualifizierungsprogramm. Projektleiter, Ingenieure, Maschinenbauer, Handwerksmeister und Immobilienmakler finden bei uns einen schnellen Einstieg in alle Themen rund um die energetische Sanierung. ENERDOMO Sanierungssprint Ein- und Zweifamilienhäuser werden in 22 Werktagen energetisch saniert. Ein Taktplan steuert die Gewerke, die parallel arbeiten. Die Sanierungssprintkoordination übernimmt Baubegleitung, Bauzeitenplanung sowie die Koordinierung der Gewerke. Zukunftsmarkt mit Sinn „Grüne Jobs“ sind dabei mehr als ein Trend. Umwelt- und Energieberufe gehören zu den wichtigsten Zukunftsmärkten. ENERDOMO gibt Know-how an Existenzgründer und Quereinsteiger weiter, die Verantwortung übernehmen und etwas Eigenes aufbauen wollen. Aufgaben Wir helfen Immobilienbesitzern (privat und gewerblich), Fördermittel für energetische Sanierungen zu beantragen. Dazu erstellen wir einen Sanierungsfahrplan (iSFP) und unterstützen bei den baulichen Maßnahmen. Statt die Arbeit von Architekten, Dachdeckern oder Heizungsbauern zu ersetzen, kooperieren wir eng mit ihnen. Als Geschäftsführer und ENERDOMO-Partner übernehmen Sie dabei folgende Aufgaben: Aufbau Ihrer eigenen, lokalen Präsenz von ENERDOMO, inklusive eines Netzwerkes aus Handwerkern und eventuellen Mitarbeitern Beraten von Kunden zu allen Fragen rund um die Gebäude-Sanierung und verfügbaren Fördermittel Beantragen von Fördermitteln mit oder für den Kunden Vor-Ort Begehung von Gebäuden zur Aufnahme von Gebäude-Daten Erstellung von individuellen Sanierungsfahrplänen (iSFP) in Hottgenroth Erstellungen von Zusatzleistungen wie z.B. Energieausweisen oder Heizlastberechnungen Schreiben von Angeboten und Rechnungen in Lexware Office Qualifikation Ein erfolgreicher Geschäftsführer im Bereich der Energieberatung sollte folgende Qualifikationen mitbringen: Interesse am Energiesektor: Kenntnisse über Immobilien, Produkte und Dienstleistungen sowie die Fähigkeit, sich in dieses Thema einzuarbeiten. Führungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Leitung von Teams und der Entwicklung von Geschäftsbeziehungen. Unternehmerisches Denken: Fähigkeit, neue Ideen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten umzusetzen und Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Betrieb des Standorts zu übernehmen. Finanzielle Kenntnisse: Kenntnisse in Budgetplanung, -analyse und -berichterstattung zur Sicherstellung des erfolgreichen Betriebs. Marketing- und Vertriebskenntnisse: Fähigkeit, erfolgreiche Marketing- und Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, um neue Kunden zu gewinnen und den Umsatz zu steigern. Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, Mitarbeitern und Geschäftspartnern zu kommunizieren und zu präsentieren. Sie benötigen: Technisches Verständnis Nachweisbare Erfahrung mit technischen Anlagen Zusätzlich vorteilhaft: Ein Abschluss in einem technischen Studiengang oder einer berufsbildenden höheren Schule. Dies ist jedoch keine Voraussetzung bei ENERDOMO. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Befähigungsprüfung zum Energieberater. Quereinsteiger: Selbst wenn Sie kein Handwerksmeister, Ingenieur oder Architekt sind, können Sie mit unserer Hilfe die „Qualifikationsprüfung Energieberatung“ erfolgreich ablegen. Benefits Gestalten Sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen innerhalb eines erprobten Geschäftsmodells Profitieren Sie vom ENERDOMO-Netzwerk: Erhalten Sie die Unterstützung bestehender ENERDOMO-Partner bei fachlichen Fragen und wachsen Sie gemeinsam mit uns in einem aufstrebenden Markt. Unterstützung im Marketing durch die Systemzentrale: Konzentrieren Sie sich ganz auf den Vertrieb und Ihre Kunden Unterstützung beim Aufbringen der Startgebühr und der Finanzierung der Selbstständigkeit mithilfe fachkundiger Inhouse-Beratung durch einen unserer Experten wie zum Beispiel Dr. Arthur Schäfer CO₂ runter, Umsätze hoch! Mit ENERDOMO gestalten wir aktiv die energetische Zukunft der Immobilienberatung. Mit einer starken Marke. Aber noch wichtiger: mit starken Partnern. Deshalb rücken wir am liebsten Menschen wie Patrik Brings ins Rampenlicht. Denn letztlich geht es nicht um Logos, sondern um echte Persönlichkeiten – mit Profil, klarer Haltung und einer echten Story. Warum setzen wir so auf Personal Branding?Weil Menschen am liebsten mit Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Weil Persönlichkeit die besten Kunden anzieht – und gleichzeitig die passenden Mitarbeiter. Weil jeder Partner einzigartig ist und genau das sichtbar werden soll. Patrik hat sich entschieden, Gesicht zu zeigen – heute steht er nicht nur für ENERDOMO, sondern ist die Adresse Nr. 1 in Koblenz, wenn es um energetische Sanierung geht. Brings sagt: „Die Entscheidung für ENERDOMO war eine der besten meines Lebens. Jetzt unterstütze ich Menschen dabei, ihre Immobilien zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Diese Aufgabe ist wirtschaftlich äußerst attraktiv und gibt meinem Leben einen echten Sinn." Du fühlst dich davon angesprochen und tickst ähnlich wie wir bei ENERDOMO – Das Original?
