title: Expert Financial Performance & Value Creation (m/w/d)
description: Die Chance Steuerberatungen rechnen rückwärts. Sie wissen genau, was im letzten Jahr passiert ist, und erstaunlich wenig darüber, welches Mandat, welche Leistung und welcher Mitarbeiter morgen Geld verdient. Vogel erwirbt eigenständige Beratungsunternehmen und baut sie zur stärksten Adresse ihrer Region aus. Mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Wir wachsen aus dem Bestand und durch Übernahmen. Beides stellt dieselbe Frage in zwei Formen: Was verdienen unsere Mandate, Leistungen und Teams tatsächlich, und was folgt daraus für die nächsten zwölf Monate. Die Rolle ist auf ein bis drei Jahre Beratungserfahrung zugeschnitten. Du treibst die finanzielle Steuerung von der Ertragsseite her. Du siehst auf die Zahlen, erkennst, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, und gehst damit zu den Menschen, die es ändern können, auch wenn das Gespräch unangenehm wird. So lange, bis die Wirkung in den Zahlen steht. Du berichtest an Moritz Bonacker. Was du verantwortest Ertragskraft und Produktivität Durchleuchte die Bestände auf den echten Daten des laufenden Rechnungswesens, von der Mandatsgröße bis zum Deckungsbeitrag, und mach sichtbar, was heute stillschweigend miterbracht und nicht abgerechnet wird. Bewerte die Produktivität auf beiden Seiten: je Leistungsart, welche ihren Deckungsbeitrag trägt und welche quersubventioniert wird, und je Mitarbeiter, wo Wertschöpfung je eingesetzter Stunde entsteht. Dein Maßstab: keine Analyse ohne benannte Maßnahme, benannten Verantwortlichen und benanntes Datum. Durchsetzung Führ die Honorargespräche selbst oder mit einem Berufsträger an deiner Seite. Und sprich auch die unangenehmen Fälle aus: Nicht jedes Mandat hat einen Weg in die Profitabilität. Geh mit deinen Zahlen direkt zu den fachlich Verantwortlichen: was ihre Mandate und Teams produzieren, wo Ertrag liegen bleibt, was sich konkret ändern muss. Verfolge die Maßnahmen nach, bis das Ergebnis in den Zahlen steht. Auch wenn es unbequem wird. Zukauf und Vorausschau Entwickle je Übernahme den Wertsteigerungsplan auf der finanziellen Seite und verfolge ihn über Jahre statt über hundert Tage. Dein Maßstab: Die dritte Übernahme läuft besser als die erste, weil du beide gemacht hast. Verantworte Umsatz- und Ergebnisprognose, Budgets, Szenarien und Abweichungsanalysen über alle Standorte, auch die neu dazugekommenen. Automatisiere, was du baust. Keine Auswertung, die jemand monatlich manuell zusammensetzt. Fragen, auf die du die Antwort findest Ein Mandat trägt seinen Deckungsbeitrag nicht, die Beziehung besteht seit fünfzehn Jahren: Wie gehst du in dieses Gespräch, und wo ist deine Grenze? Woran unterscheidest du eine Leistung, die zu billig ist, von einer, die zu aufwendig erbracht wird? Deine Empfehlung wird von jemandem blockiert, der dir nicht berichtet. Was tust du, wenn das zweite Gespräch auch nichts bringt? Woran wir Erfolg messen Nach 6 Monaten: Der erste Bestand ist vollständig durchgerechnet, Deckungsbeitrag je Mandat und Leistungsart liegen belastbar vor, die erste Auswertung läuft automatisiert, die ersten Honorargespräche hast du selbst geführt. Nach 12 Monaten: Die erste Anpassungswelle ist über den Bestand gefahren, das erreichte Honorarniveau nachgewiesen. Die Deckungsbeitragsrechnung wird in Führungsentscheidungen verwendet. Deine Prognose trägt, ihre Abweichung kannst du erklären. Nach 24 Monaten: Mehrere Übernahmen begleitet, die spätere lief nachweislich besser als die erste. Die Steuerung läuft weitgehend automatisiert, dein Anteil hat sich von der Aufbereitung zur Interpretation verschoben. Wohin es führt: in die Senior-Stufe der fachlichen Expertenlaufbahn, mit größerem Themenfeld und mehr methodischer Autorität. Willst du ein Team aufbauen, steht dir die Führungslaufbahn ebenso offen. Entschieden am Beitrag und nicht am Berufsjahr. Was du mitbringst Du hast ein bis drei Jahre in der Beratung gearbeitet, in der Strategieberatung, in Transaction Services oder in einem Wertsteigerungs-Team: kommerzielle Prüfung, Pricing, Ergebnisverbesserung. Du führst unangenehme Gespräche, statt sie aufzuschieben, ob es um Geld oder um Leistung geht, und hältst deine Position, wenn Widerspruch kommt. Du beherrschst Excel jenseits von Pivot-Tabellen und liest eine Buchführung, ohne Steuerberater zu sein. SQL oder Python sind kein Zusatz, sondern der Weg, dieselbe Auswertung nicht zweimal von Hand zu bauen. Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Datenanalyse, Mustererkennung in Bestandsdaten und Drafting. Du bewegst Menschen ohne Weisungsbefugnis, über eine Rechnung, die niemand bestreiten kann, und über einen Ton, der Widerstand nicht erzeugt. title: Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen. Gerade jetzt stehen wir an einem spannenden Punkt: Als Scale-up migrieren und konsolidieren wir unsere Infrastruktur von einzelnen Systemen auf einen skalierbaren Cloud-Stack, bei laufendem Betrieb, ohne Abstriche bei Uptime und Performance. Dafür suchen wir einen Tech Lead AI DevOps / Infrastructure (w/m/d) , der unsere Infrastruktur ganzheitlich verantwortet: Du baust sie auf, skalierst sie und schaffst damit die Grundlage, auf der unser Team wachsen kann. Das machst du mit einem kleinen DevOps-Team, das du führst. Langfristig sorgst du mit deinem Team dafür, dass unsere Engineering-Teams im Rahmen eines Agentic SDLC ihre Produkte effizient auf sicherer und skalierbarer Infrastruktur shippen können. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest als DevOps Tech Lead, das heißt du bist aktiver Contributor (Player & Coach) mit Führungsverantwortung für ein kleines Team und berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Engineering Du verantwortest die Skalierung, Wartung und Sicherung unserer gesamten Cloud-Infrastruktur, von der laufenden Migration bis zum stabilen Tagesbetrieb, und legst damit das Fundament, auf dem Team und Produkt wachsen können Du baust saubere Prozesse für Monitoring, Uptime, Backups und Recovery, Access Management, Security-Updates und Kostenkontrolle auf, wo heute noch vieles gewachsen und unstrukturiert ist Du setzt AI gezielt im DevOps-Alltag ein, von Incident-Analyse über Infrastruktur-Code bis hin zu Runbooks, und automatisierst wiederkehrende Betriebsaufgaben konsequent, damit ein kleines Team maximale Wirkung erzielt Du stellst sicher, dass interne und externe Entwicklung zuverlässig von DevOps unterstützt wird Du bereitest die Weiterentwicklung des Teams hin zu Platform Engineering für unseren Standort Berlin vor. Was du mitbringst 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in DevOps, SRE oder Platform Engineering, davon erste Lead-Verantwortung (Architektur, technische Entscheidungen, Mentoring) Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestütztem DevOps, also dem Einsatz von AI zur Automatisierung und Sicherung von Betrieb und Infrastruktur Fundierte Kenntnisse in Infrastructure as Code und Container-Orchestrierung, z. B. mit Terraform, Kubernetes und Ansible Erfahrung im Betrieb eines Enterprise-Stacks mit vielen Komponenten (Data Warehouses, Applikationen, Datenbanken, Logging, Security Audits, Berechtigungssysteme) und ein sicheres Gefühl für Security, Backups und Recovery. Disziplin bei CI/CD, Monitoring und Observability (z. B. GitHub Actions, Grafana, Prometheus o. ä.) title: Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering (f/m/d)
description: OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions. We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Supported by smart AI features exactly where they make a real difference in everyday work. Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow. YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT As a Working Student / Intern GTM AI Growth Engineering , you build and launch AI-powered growth experiments that create new qualified demand for plancraft across Europe. From interactive calculators and landing pages to AI-powered tools, you turn ideas into live experiments, measure their impact on revenue, and scale what works. You help build an automated, intelligence-driven go-to-market engine that grows without adding manual work. Your Responsibilities Build and launch AI-powered acquisition experiments using tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor – from interactive calculators and landing pages to simple AI widgets. Own the experiment pipeline – collect ideas, prioritize them by expected revenue impact and effort, and continuously prepare the next tests. Measure what works – define clear hypotheses, set up tracking with GA4, Mixpanel, and HubSpot, and evaluate experiments based on qualified leads, pipeline, and conversion. Automate lead generation – connect experiments to HubSpot, ensuring leads are captured, qualified, and routed with clean data and minimal manual effort. Scale successful experiments internationally – adapt winning tools and campaigns for international markets like Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands. Document learnings and share results – write concise experiment briefs, report outcomes transparently, and present your latest experiments in our weekly RevOps meeting. Turn experiments into scalable solutions – hand over successful initiatives to the responsible teams and shut down unsuccessful tests efficiently. Collaborate across Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to ensure experiments follow our brand, tracking, and data standards while generating actionable insights for future growth. YOUR PROFILE Must-haves: You’re currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program (at least two semesters completed), ideally in Industrial Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical or business-technical field. You've already built and launched something independently – whether an app, website, automation, or side project. It doesn't need to be perfect, but it needs to work. You're comfortable using at least one AI building tool such as Lovable, Claude, or Cursor and can understand basic HTML, JavaScript, and API documentation. You understand the fundamentals of digital acquisition funnels and can connect an experiment hypothesis to a measurable outcome. You take ownership from idea to execution, learn new tools independently, and prioritize shipping and learning over unnecessary perfection. You communicate clearly, document your work concisely, and are comfortable sharing results openly – including experiments that didn't succeed. You have fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. You're available for 16–20 hours per week during the semester and remain enrolled at university throughout your working student contract. For an internship, you can commit to at least four months, ideally six months . You are based in Hamburg or willing to relocate to Hamburg for the duration of your internship or working student position. Nice-to-haves: Initial experience with GA4, Mixpanel, landing page optimization, SEO, copywriting, or conversion tracking. Experience with automation tools like n8n or working with APIs. Familiarity with HubSpot, Webflow, Figma, Linear, GitHub, Asana, or Claude Code. Experience launching a project with real users – whether through a startup, university initiative, personal project, or public launch. Interest in tradespeople, small businesses, and understanding how digital tools can improve their daily work. German skills at C1 level or additional language skills in Italian, Spanish, Dutch, or Polish. WHY PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit : We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together. Ownership : You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact. Learning & Growth : We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential. AI Enablement : Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work. Tech & Tooling : You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing. Recharge : To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups. Mobility : You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute. International Environment : We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for. ______ On the application process We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you. Note on creating a test account: If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.</p> <p>Heute sind wir ein Team von rund <strong>100 Mitarbeitenden</strong>, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt <strong>18 Millionen Euro Funding</strong> eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).</p> <p>Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.<br><br><em>In dieser Rolle bist du dafür verantwortlich, den Umsatz aus unserem bestehenden Kundenstamm zu steigern. Als erste Person im Account Management unseres Teams, das bisher vor allem auf Neukundengewinnung ausgerichtet ist, trägst du direkt zu unserem Wachstum bei.</em></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p><strong>3+ Jahre Account Management Experience.</strong><br>Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre erfolgreich im Account Management eines SaaS-Unternehmens gearbeitet und kannst messbare Upsell-Erfolge vorweisen.</p> <p><strong>Relationship Builder.</strong><br>Du baust Beziehungen innerhalb eines Unternehmens gezielt aus, verstehst seine Strukturen und weißt, wer welche Entscheidungen trifft.</p> <p><strong>Solution-Minded.</strong><br>Du verstehst komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen und übersetzt sie in überzeugende Upgrade-Cases.</p> <p><strong>SaaS Fluency.</strong><br>Du verstehst SaaS-Geschäftsmodelle in der Tiefe und weißt, wie du sie nutzt, um für deine Kund:innen den größten Mehrwert zu schaffen. Erfahrung mit HubSpot ist ein Plus.</p> <p><strong>Highly Numerate.</strong><br>Du verstehst die Business-Treiber deiner Kund:innen und kannst den Impact einer Lösung mit Zahlen greifbar machen.</p> <p><strong>Structured.</strong><br>Du arbeitest mit einer klaren Sales-Methodik und baust für deine Accounts durchdachte Account-Pläne auf.</p> <p><strong>Self-Starter.</strong><br>Du übernimmst Verantwortung für dein Segment, gehst mit hoher Energie und Fokus an deine Ziele und arbeitest dabei gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.</p> <p><strong>Strong communicator.</strong><br>Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch, verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und drückst dich schriftlich wie mündlich klar und überzeugend aus.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
description: About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni) AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Role summary How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality? We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware. What you will do Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact. Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy. Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents. Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios. A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff. Core qualifications Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program. Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations. Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output. An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results. Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team. Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization. title: Satellite Systems Engineer (m/w/d), Space & Defense Industry
description: About the Company Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore. The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension. With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector. Infinite Orbits is looking for the founding team for its Munich site. Candidates who bring entrepreneurial drive, thrive in ambiguity, want ownership over what they build, and want to make a real difference in space are invited to explore the open positions on the company's website. Job Description About the Role As Satellite Systems Engineer, you own the spacecraft. You turn the agreed mission concept into a buildable, verifiable spacecraft solution covering platform, payload, and their interfaces, drawing on the Infinite Orbits Group's platforms and on German suppliers and partners. Proposal preparation is a core part of this role: you author the spacecraft design sections of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids, RFI/RFP responses, and funding applications. You substantiate sizing, heritage, and maturity, consolidate supplier input, and make sure that what we offer can be built, verified, and delivered within the cost and schedule we commit to. You work hand in hand with the Mission Systems Engineer, who owns the mission concept, and the Proposal & Project Manager, who runs the proposal process. Once contracts are won, you carry the spacecraft design through reviews, verification, and integration, and you help build up spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Munich as our German hardware content grows. Spacecraft proposal content: Author the spacecraft design sections of RFI/RFP responses, customer proposals, and national and European funding applications, covering configuration, subsystem and payload selection, spacecraft budgets, heritage and maturity (TRL) justification, compliance, and technical risks. Cost & schedule input for bids: Provide the Proposal & Project Manager with the technical basis for proposal cost and schedule, including make-or-buy decisions, supplier selection, procurement lead times, and verification and integration effort. Supplier & partner input: Request, assess, and consolidate technical offers from suppliers and partners into a coherent proposal baseline. Spacecraft requirements & budgets: Own spacecraft-level requirements derived from the mission baseline and manage spacecraft budgets (mass, power, thermal, link, pointing, propellant) through design and delivery. Interfaces & integration: Define and manage platform, payload, and subsystem interfaces (ICDs), including the integration of payloads and subsystems from German partners. Design reviews & verification: Prepare spacecraft design reviews and own verification and test planning at spacecraft level. Project execution: Own spacecraft engineering workstreams on won contracts, ensuring delivery against technical and contractual requirements. Group coordination: Work closely with platform engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to reuse existing designs and keep the spacecraft baseline consistent across the Group. Capability build-up: Support the build-up of spacecraft integration and verification capability in Germany as the German hardware share grows. Requirements Education & Experience Engineering degree in aerospace, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent. 3+ years of experience in spacecraft systems engineering, ideally at platform, prime, or integrator level. Experience contributing spacecraft design, cost, or schedule content to technical proposals in the space or defense sector. Experience with spacecraft integration, verification, or AIT is a plus. Skills & Other Requirements Strong command of spacecraft subsystems and their interactions (AOCS/GNC, power, thermal, propulsion, communications, structures, data handling). Working knowledge of ECSS standards and spacecraft verification approaches. Ability to size and defend spacecraft solutions, including heritage and maturity claims, under customer or stakeholder scrutiny. Excellent structured writing: able to turn design work into clear, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure. Experience working with suppliers and partners on technical offers and interface definitions. Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond. Fluent in German and English. Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung). Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations. What we offer A founding technical role with direct ownership of spacecraft design and proposal content in a growing European space and defense company. Direct influence on how Infinite Orbits builds spacecraft engineering and integration capability in Germany, in close collaboration with the Infinite Orbits Group. We are looking forward to your application! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Manager (m/w/d), Raumfahrt & Verteidigung
description: Über das Unternehmen Die Infinite Orbits GmbH ist die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft der Infinite Orbits SAS, eines 2017 gegründeten NewSpace-Unternehmens mit heute mehr als 200 Mitarbeitenden und Standorten unter anderem in Luxemburg, Großbritannien, Spanien und Singapur. Das Unternehmen entwickelt In-Orbit-Servicing-Lösungen auf Basis seiner eigenen autonomen Rendezvous- und Proximity-Operations-Technologie (RPO): von Lageerfassung, Überwachung, Inspektion und Schutz von Weltrauminfrastruktur bis hin zur Lebensdauerverlängerung von Satelliten. Mit dem neuen Standort in München baut Infinite Orbits eine eigene Präsenz in Deutschland auf und entwickelt Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Business Development, Forschung und Entwicklung, Produktentwicklung, Systems Engineering, Produktion und Missionsbetrieb, um den europäischen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtsektor zu stärken. Infinite Orbits sucht das Gründungsteam für den Standort München. Gesucht werden Menschen mit unternehmerischem Antrieb, die sich in offenen, wenig strukturierten Situationen wohlfühlen, Verantwortung für das übernehmen möchten, was sie aufbauen, und die Raumfahrt aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Angebotsführung: Verantwortung für Win-Strategie, Preisgestaltung, kaufmännische und vertragliche Bedingungen sowie Teaming-Vereinbarungen; Mitwirkung an den vom Proposal & Project Manager geleiteten Angebotsreviews; Führung von Klärungsrunden und Vertragsverhandlungen. Partnerschaften & Teaming: Aufbau von Partnerschaften und Konsortien mit der deutschen Industrie, KMU und Forschungseinrichtungen für gemeinsame Angebote und Programme. Beschaffungs- und Förderprogramme: Beobachtung nationaler und europäischer Beschaffungs- und Förderinstrumente in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung und Qualifizierung von Opportunities, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den R&D and Innovation Managern. Marktbeobachtung: Analyse von Kundenprogrammen, Budgets, Wettbewerbern und Partnerlandschaft; Einbringen der Erkenntnisse in die Produktpositionierung und das Angebot der Gruppe. Repräsentation: Vertretung von Infinite Orbits auf Messen, Konferenzen, Kundentagen und in Industrieverbänden. Gruppenkoordination: Abstimmung mit Business Development und Vertrieb der Infinite-Orbits-Gruppe zu Account-Strategie, Angeboten und Preisgestaltung für einen einheitlichen Kundenauftritt. B. im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, in der technischen Leitung oder in der kaufmännischen Leitung. Erfahrung in kundennaher Tätigkeit, mit Angeboten oder mit öffentlichen Programmen ist von Vorteil. Ein etabliertes Netzwerk im deutschen Verteidigungs- und Raumfahrtumfeld (Bundeswehr, Beschaffungsorganisationen, DLR, Industrie) ist ein großer Vorteil. Fähigkeiten & weitere Anforderungen Fundiertes Verständnis deutscher und europäischer Vergabeverfahren in Raumfahrt und Verteidigung. Ausreichendes technisches Verständnis von Raumfahrtsystemen, um In-Orbit-Servicing- und RPO-Lösungen mit Kunden glaubwürdig zu diskutieren. Kaufmännisches Gespür und Verhandlungssicherheit gegenüber Kunden und Partnern. title: Lead AI Engineer
description: We are AI builders Since 2018, Enjins has done one thing: ship AI that works in production. From Utrecht and Berlin, we build machine learning systems, data infrastructure, and agentic AI layers for European tech companies, with a deliberate focus on climate and energy, where we believe the biggest technological shift of our generation should meet its most critical challenge. We embed directly with the engineering teams of high-growth scale-ups like Crisp, PlanBlue, NextSense, and Groendus. We take ownership of the full technical lifecycle: from first architecture decision to a production-grade system running inside our partner's infrastructure, long after go-live. The role As Lead AI Engineer, you are the technical owner of client engagements. You architect the solution, ship it to production, and make sure it still performs a year later. Alongside the other Leads, you shape the engineering team and the way we build. In practice: Design AI roadmaps with client leadership and own them through to production Create and implement the AI solution architectures to deliver on those roadmaps Set and uphold Data Platform and MLOps standards across your client portfolio, so systems stay healthy after handover Mentor engineers and weigh in on hiring, team growth, and accounts Push our engineering practice forward, including how we use agentic coding workflows to build faster without compromising reliability. We test, document, and share what works, so the whole team levels up Elevate our product mindset to ensure we build the right things, not just more things Why a Lead role here, not somewhere else You'll work across more stacks, clouds, and frontier frameworks in a year than most engineers see in five, with the collective knowledge of the whole team behind you, not the isolation of freelance work. And because our clients build grid software, energy forecasting, and climate infrastructure, you develop real domain expertise in energy and climate systems on top of production-grade AI engineering. In your first months you'll join a client project alongside an experienced Enjins engineer, supported by a dedicated coach. Within half a year, you own the technical roadmap of at least one engagement, mentor engineers, and have a recognised voice in our Asset strategy. Requirements What matters most: you think in systems, own outcomes end-to-end, and grow the people around you. 5+ years building and scaling data & AI solutions in production environments Strong software engineering fundamentals: you write production-grade code and know your way around infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, data pipelines) Mastery of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience leading MLOps/LLMOps architectures Proven experience taking LLM-based or agentic systems to production Experience mentoring engineers, overseeing delivery, and managing client accounts You can translate technical complexity into clear decisions for non-technical stakeholders Fluent in English and eligible to work in the Netherlands Benefits We publish our salary ranges and keep terms straightforward. No surprises. Compensation €5,950 - €7,800 gross per month (excl. holiday allowance, pension, bonus, equity, and AI-Leap benefits) Annual performance bonus of 1.5 months' salary Equity participation (VSOP) Growth AI-Leap: our structured development programme with a dedicated certification budget and a specialised track for Leads 1-on-1 mentoring with our founders and external coaching to close your specific gaps Team & culture Office on the Oudegracht in Utrecht (note: not yet fully accessible for individuals with physical disabilities); hybrid setup 28 vacation days, flexible across 3 national holidays Monthly team events and the annual two-day Enjins Summer Summit on AI × Climate OV-First travel policy, fully covered; meat-free catering Apple MacBook Pro and the tools you need Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Solutions Architect - EMEA
description: <h3><strong>About Us</strong></h3> <p>AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.<br><br>The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.<br><br>AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.<br><br>The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.<br><br>Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.<br><br>Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.</p> <h2 id="How-You’ll-Make-an-Impact" data-renderer-start-pos="876"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">How You’ll Make an Impact</u></strong></h2> <p>As a Solutions Architect at Endor Labs, you're at the heart of connecting our innovative team with our diverse and dynamic customers. Every day presents a new set of exciting challenges and opportunities to make a significant impact:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Educate with Enthusiasm:</strong> Elevate awareness about Application Security and Software Supply Chain Security. It's about making security engaging and accessible to developers everywhere.</li> <li><strong>Master Our Tech:</strong> Deep dive into our supply chain security product suite and emerge as the go-to expert and evangelist.</li> <li><strong>Deliver Tailored Demos:</strong> Showcase our solutions in a way that speaks directly to the needs and challenges of our customers. Be the architect of captivating, solution-oriented presentations.</li> <li><strong>Shape Customer Outcomes:</strong> Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to design solutions that genuinely address customer challenges. Your insights from the field will directly influence our product development, ensuring we always meet our customers' evolving needs.</li> <li><strong>Facilitate Customer Success:</strong> Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of the Endor Labs solution. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You Bring to the Table</strong></span></h2> <p>We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! You'll fit right in if you have:</p> <ul> <li data-section-id="poqw43" data-start="297" data-end="491"><strong data-start="299" data-end="319">Rich Experience:</strong> You have experience in pre-sales or a similar customer-facing, technical role. You're no stranger to technical deep dives, product demonstrations, and leading evaluations.</li> <li data-section-id="hrgdhb" data-start="493" data-end="841"><strong data-start="495" data-end="527">Strong Technical Foundation:</strong> A solid understanding of modern software development practices, including backend or full-stack development experience, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based development workflows, and DevOps tooling. You’re comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams and understanding how modern applications are built and deployed.</li> <li data-section-id="44alsd" data-start="843" data-end="1108"><strong data-start="845" data-end="880">Application Security Awareness:</strong> Familiarity with application security concepts, software supply chain security, and/or identity & access management principles. You understand the importance of securing developer workflows and modern cloud-native environments.</li> <li data-section-id="xiq5d5" data-start="1110" data-end="1310"><strong data-start="1112" data-end="1127">Tech Savvy:</strong> A robust understanding of the Developer, DevOps, Application Security, and open-source ecosystems. Hopefully, you can meet developers where they are and flex some programming skills.</li> <li data-section-id="otuo74" data-start="1312" data-end="1493"><strong data-start="1314" data-end="1342">Customer & Sales Skills:</strong> You've successfully engaged with technical customers at an Enterprise level and know how to articulate complex solutions and operate in a sales cycle.</li> <li data-section-id="roopa0" data-start="1495" data-end="1625"><strong data-start="1497" data-end="1528">Curious and Eager to Learn:</strong> Always on the lookout for new technologies and understanding the intricacies of how things work.</li> <li data-section-id="12ecp9k" data-start="1627" data-end="1739"><strong data-start="1629" data-end="1654">Collaborative Spirit:</strong> You thrive in a team setting and value diversity and inclusion in every interaction.</li> <li data-section-id="25v10y" data-start="1741" data-end="1840"><strong data-start="1743" data-end="1763">Action-oriented:</strong> You prefer actively solving customer problems and asking for help as needed.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What Makes Us... Us</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.</li> <li>Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.</li> <li>Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.</li> <li>Strive to make the complex simple.</li> <li>Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.</li> <li>Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.</li> <li>Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.</li> <li>Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What We Offer You</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans. </li> <li>401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.</li> <li>Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)</li> <li>Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.</li> <li>A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</strong> We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4857"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Compensation: </strong>For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $190,000 - $250,000. This may include additional incentives such as commission targets, restricted stock units, and/or bonuses, depending on the role.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <p><strong>Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Amsterdam ( preferred), or London <br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead<br><strong>Role type:</strong> Full-time</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.</p> <p>This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.</p> <p>This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role combining:</p> <ul> <li>Deep power systems expertise</li> <li>Top-tier strategy problem solving</li> <li>Origination and senior client leadership</li> <li>Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes</li> <li>Team leadership and platform-building</li> </ul> <p>You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Power Systems & Grid Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.</li> <li>Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.</li> <li>Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strategic Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.</li> <li>Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.</li> <li>Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Systems Change & Platform Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.</li> <li>Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.</li> <li>Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.</li> <li>Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Origination & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and mentor high-performing teams.</li> <li>Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Candidate Profile</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.</p> <p><strong>Essential Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy</li> <li>Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory</li> <li>Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.</li> <li>Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.</li> <li>Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.</li> <li>Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.</li> <li>Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Core Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.</li> <li>Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.</li> <li>Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or title: Senior Consultant - Corporate, Issues & Crisis
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a> </p> <p>For more information visit <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Consultant in Burson’s Corporate practice you will lead high-profile corporate communications and issues mandates for some of the most recognised organisations across the Netherlands. You will be the counsel clients turn to when reputation is on the line, leading integrated teams to deliver outstanding work that protects, builds and advances their standing with the audiences that matter most.</p> <p>We are looking for someone with deep corporate communications expertise and proven issues experience, who understands how reputation, policy and public sentiment intersect, and who can guide clients with confidence through a fast-moving and often complex landscape.</p> <p>You’ll be someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and is experienced in working with globally recognised organisations who lead their fields and expect their communications to as well.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Trusted client counsel</strong>: Serve as the trusted senior point of contact for clients, providing strategic corporate communications and issues counsel, and developing a comprehensive understanding of client objectives, stakeholders and sector dynamics across industries such as Energy, Healthcare or Technology.</li> <li><strong>Media & Stakeholder knowledge</strong>: You’ll have a nose for news and a sharp understanding of the political, regulatory and media environment, and know how to develop insightful corporate and public affairs strategies.</li> <li><strong>Issues & Crisis:</strong> Anticipate, prepare for and manage reputational issues and live crises – developing scenario planning, positioning and response strategies that protect and strengthen client reputation under pressure.</li> <li><strong>Corporate & public affairs strategy</strong>: Shape and deliver integrated programmes that connect corporate narrative, stakeholder engagement and public affairs, ensuring clients’ voices land with policymakers, media, employees and the wider public.</li> <li><strong>Planning and creativity</strong>: Know what cuts through in the corporate, policy and issues space, and develop creative storytelling and content that builds reputation and earns meaningful engagement.</li> <li><strong>Day-to-day leader & quality control</strong>: Direct overall account activity, ensuring seamless execution, brilliant delivery, and consistently high levels of client service.</li> <li><strong>Proactivity</strong>: Drive innovative execution across day-to-day corporate communications, campaigns and issues management.</li> <li><strong>Team player</strong>: Play an active and helpful part in client teams and broader Burson initiatives, demonstrating effective time management and acting as an agency ambassador.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Established corporate communications experience at Senior Manager or Account Director level, ideally within an agency, with demonstrable issues and/or crisis experience.</li> <li>Sector knowledge in one or more of Energy, Healthcare or Technology, with an understanding of the reputational, regulatory and stakeholder issues that shape these industries.</li> <li>Proven experience across Corporate and Issues & Crisis, with a strong understanding of how to build and deliver effective reputation and stakeholder strategies for the modern media and policy era.</li> <li>A robust network of relevant media, policy, and stakeholder contacts.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage fast-paced, ambitious clients and dynamic portfolios, providing exceptional client counsel.</li> <li>Energetic and committed team leadership experience, capable of inspiring and motivating teams.</li> <li>High levels of intelligence, initiative, and integrity, with an ambition to create award-winning work.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and time management skills, coupled with a commitment to day-to-day excellence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our  <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it. </p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who We Are</strong></h4> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.</p></div><h3><strong>About the role</strong></h3> <p>WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.</p> <p>Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a <strong>Senior Technical SEO Specialist</strong> to strengthen our technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.</p> <p>You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities will include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.</li> <li>Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.</li> <li>Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.</li> <li>Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.</li> <li>Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.</li> <li>Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.</li> <li>Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.</li> <li>Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.</li> <li>Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.</li> <li>Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>The technical expertise we are looking for</strong></h3> <p>For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.</p> <p><strong>You have a strong understanding of:</strong></p> <ul> <li>HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.</li> <li>HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.</li> <li>JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.</li> <li>Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.</li> <li>Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.</li> <li>txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.</li> <li>Structured data and Schema.org.</li> <li>Core Web Vitals and web performance.</li> <li>International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.</li> <li>Website and platform migrations.</li> <li>Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.</li> </ul> <p>You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.</p> <h3>What seniority means to us</h3> <p>Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.</p> <p>We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.</p> <h3>You will also:</h3> <ul> <li>Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.</li> <li>Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.</li> <li>Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.</li> <li>Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.</li> <li>Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.</li> <li>Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.</li> <li>Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.</li> </ul> <p>Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.</p> <h3><strong>What you'll need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.</li> <li>Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.</li> <li>Strong experience working with <strong>l</strong>arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.</li> <li>Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.</li> <li>A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.</li> <li>An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.</li> <li>Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer:</strong> </h3> <p>We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. <br> <br><strong>Our compensation:</strong> </p> <ul> <li>A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.</li> <li>Hybrid working flexibility.</li> <li>Access to learning platforms .</li> <li>Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. </li> <li>Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. </li> <li>Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. </li> <li>At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. </li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>About WPP</strong></h4> <p class="p1">WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Why Join Us?</span></strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">You own configuration management for our unmanned systems, from the first baseline to the unit in the customer's hands. You set and hold the baselines, run change control with the engineering teams, and keep every drawing, document and software release traceable to the product it describes. You join a new configuration management team in Systems Engineering that is growing, with room for you to take on more responsibility.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The role sits between systems engineering, hardware and software development, production, quality and logistics support. Our products move from design iteration to series production quickly and under the scrutiny of defence customers and authorities, so you build configuration management that holds up in a customer audit and keeps pace with engineering.</span></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Configuration management governance</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li style="font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Own the configuration management plan and process in line with title: Head of Go-to-Market, AI Care Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.</p> <p>Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.</p> <p> </p> <h4>AI Proficiency at Sword</h4> <p>AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.</p> <ul> <li> <p>Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity</p> </li> <li> <p>Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team</p> </li> <li> <p>Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale</p> </li> </ul> <p>Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.</p> <p> </p></div><p>AI Care Operations (previously Sword Intelligence), is Sword's AI care management division. We don't deliver a clinical program to members. We deploy AI Care Managers, trained on more than 14 million real care interactions, to run the operations of providers, payers and national health systems.</p> <p>It started as an internal problem. On the way to freeing over a million people from pain, Sword hit the same wall every healthcare organization does: we didn't have enough hands to scale the care we needed to provide. Instead of hiring our way out, we built AI to do it, certified it for clinical use, and ran it in our own operations before offering it to anyone else.</p> <p>Today we sell two families of solutions:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Triage</strong> — a certified Clinical Triage Line that guides every patient to the right care, 24/7, across voice and digital channels.</li> <li><strong>Care Orchestration</strong> — care navigation, population health campaigns (screenings, vaccinations, medication adherence), surgery prehab and rehab, and readmission prevention.</li> </ul> <p>We've announced a partnership with the Hellenic Ministry of Health to build an AI-powered front door for Greece's 10 million citizens, and we work with other national health systems, health plans and providers across the US and Europe. The US is now our biggest growth opportunity, and this role is central to capturing it.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>We are hiring a Head of Go-to-Market for AI Care Operations in the US. The role sits at the intersection of product marketing, competitive intelligence and commercial enablement. It is one of the leadership roles on the AI Care Operations team, reporting to the General Manager.</p> <p>Here's the opportunity. "AI agents for healthcare" is one of the most crowded categories in the market right now. Voice AI startups, EHR vendors, care management platforms and outsourcers all claim to automate care operations, and to a buyer they can sound alike. Very few of them have certified medical devices, national-scale partnerships, or AI proven on hundreds of thousands of their own members before it was sold to anyone else. We have all three. Your job is to make that difference unmistakable.</p> <p>You will own three things:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Make our value impossible to miss.</strong> Build the narrative, positioning and competitive differentiation that make it obvious why AI Care Operations is categorically better than AI point solutions, legacy nurse lines and call centers, and the care management platforms buyers already have. That means the core messaging architecture across Triage and Care Orchestration, positioning by buyer (health plan, health system, value-based care, employer, government), battle cards, ROI frameworks, and the demos and proof that move a skeptical COO or VP of Care Management.</li> <li><strong>Make sure the commercial team can tell that story.</strong> Sword's segment sales teams sell many solutions and can't be experts in all of them. When the health plan team is in front of a Medicare Advantage plan, or the employer team is pitching a front door for a self-insured population, they come to you to scope the workflows, walk the buyer through how the agents actually work, and answer the hard questions on safety, integration and ROI.</li> <li><strong>Find, surface and pursue the opportunities.</strong> You will canvass the US and international markets systematically for the accounts, RFPs, procurements, contract renewals and budget signals that would otherwise go unnoticed: a health plan rebuilding its care management operation, a health system under readmission penalties, a state agency tendering a nurse line. You'll use AI tooling to do this faster and wider than a traditional GTM team could, then partner with the relevant segment leader to make sure each opportunity is pursued and won.</li> </ol> <h2>AI proficiency at Sword</h2> <p>AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword, and every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework: Explorer (uses AI daily for personal productivity), Builder (creates workflows and tools that lift the whole team) and Integrator (embeds AI into products and processes at scale). This role requires Builder at minimum. Come ready with real examples.</p> <h2>What you'll be doing</h2> <ul> <li>Core positioning, messaging house and narrative architecture for AI Care Operations and each of its solutions</li> <li>The category story: why AI care management that does the work beats both headcount and AI tools that only assist the people doing it</li> <li>Competitive intelligence and battle cards across voice AI and agentic AI vendors, nurse line and call center outsourcers, and care management platforms</li> <li>Buyer-facing materials: one-pagers, ROI and capacity calculators, demo scripts and recorded agent calls, case studies, RFP response library, sales decks</li> <li>Proof architecture: turning deployments into case studies and outcome metrics (contacts handled, cost per interaction, gap closure, time to care, readmissions) that a CFO will sign off on</li> <li>Solution specialist team (direct reports), paired with segment sales reps across health plans, health systems, value-based care, employers and government</li> <li>Sales and customer success enablement: training, playbooks, discovery guides, certification on each solution</li> <li>Market opportunity mapping and systematic canvassing across US segments, with a lighter watch on international tenders</li> <li>Message consistency across Sword's commercial segments and geographies, including where AI Care Operations is sold as part of the broader AI Care platform</li> <li>Voice of the market into product: what buyers ask for, where we lose, and what competitors are shipping</li> </ul> <h2>We'd love to see</h2> <p>You are currently at, or recently from, a Lead, Head, Director or VP-level GTM or product marketing role where you owned the full stack: launching products, positioning, competitive differentiation, sales enablement and market strategy. You've built things that measurably changed how deals were won.</p> <p>You can sell something that isn't a product category yet. AI Care Operations is bought by operations leaders, not benefits leaders, and it competes with a budget line (headcount, outsourcing) as much as with other vendors. You know how to make the case that replacing work is different from adding a tool, and you can tell a clean story across several solutions without it sounding like a platform pitch that means nothing.</p> <p>You think in first principles. Faced with a new buyer, your instinct is to ask what operational problem they actually have, why our agents solve it better than more staff or another vendor, and what evidence would make a skeptical COO believe it. You don't reach for a template.</p> <p>You are genuinely AI-fluent, not performatively. You've built your own workflows and loops with AI tools for market intelligence, opportunity canvassing and competitive research. title: Engineering Intern
description: About Atira Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. CRM. Atira. ERP. We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
