title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description: <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Data Platform Engineer</strong> to join the <strong>Data Platform</strong> at Smartly!</p> <p>Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.</p> <p>This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.</p> <p>Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.</p> <p>This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.</p> <h2>What you will do</h2> <ul> <li>Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.</li> <li>Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.</li> <li>Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.</li> <li>Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.</li> <li>Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.</li> <li>Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.</li> <li>Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.</li> <li>Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.</li> </ul> <h2>What we are looking for</h2> <ul> <li>Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.</li> <li>Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.</li> <li>Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.</li> <li>Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.</li> <li>Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.</li> <li>Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.</li> <li>Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.</li> </ul> <h2>Useful experience, but not required</h2> <ul> <li>DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.</li> <li>Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.</li> <li>GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.</li> <li>Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.</li> <li>Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.</li> <li>Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer you</h2> <p>At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.</p> <ul> <li>Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.</li> <li>Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.</li> <li>Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.</li> <li>Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.</li> <li>A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.</li> </ul> <h2>About Smartly</h2> <p>Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.</p> <p>We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.</p> <p>Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Smartly</strong></h2> <p>Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.</p> <p>Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.</p> <p>Visit <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://smartly.io/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://Smartly.io" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Smartly</a> to learn more.<br><br><br>The processing of your information is described in our <a href="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67ed4ab7f914accf87aa070c/698a11cb716926c1d76c1641_Smartly.io%20Group%20-%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Candidates%20-%201_2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description: About Heidi Systems Heidi Systems builds the energy OS for real estate. We help property managers and owners get their heating, water and electricity meters online, see consumption in real time and run the yearly utility billing without paper, Excel and site visits. Submetering in Germany is still mostly analog. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year. We change that end to end: we install the meters and gateways in the building, collect the data and build the web platform property managers work in. We're a small team in Berlin. Product and engineering work directly with the founders, and what you ship lands with real customers fast. The role We're looking for a best-in-class frontend engineer. Someone whose code other engineers learn from. You'll be our senior frontend engineer and own the web platform end to end: architecture, code quality and the day-to-day experience of the property managers using it. The platform is a SvelteKit and TypeScript app. It shows consumption data per building and unit, flags anomalies, manages tenants and owners, and produces the documents for the yearly billing. A lot of it is data-heavy UI, and it has to be right, because the numbers end up on invoices. You'll work closely with our backend engineers and the founders, and you'll help onboard and mentor junior developers and interns as the team grows. What you'll do Own the frontend architecture of our SvelteKit app: routing, load functions, SSR, state and how we talk to the backend via oRPC Ship features end to end, from a rough idea with the founders to production, often before the design is final Build the data-heavy parts of the product: consumption dashboards, notification rules, tenant and owner management, billing documents Set up and maintain our component library on Tailwind and DaisyUI so the UI stays consistent as we add features Raise the bar on quality: strict TypeScript, Vitest coverage, code reviews, a sane PR flow Shape the API contract together with backend (types, Zod schemas, error handling) so frontend and backend stay in sync Mentor juniors and interns through reviews and pairing What you bring 5+ years of professional frontend experience, ideally at startups or other fast-moving product teams 2+ years building production apps with Svelte and SvelteKit, with a deep understanding of its reactivity model, stores, lifecycle, routing, load functions and SSR Strong TypeScript: strict mode, generics, utility types, and the judgment to know when types help and when they get in the way Hands-on with Tailwind CSS (DaisyUI is a plus) Experience with RPC-style APIs (oRPC, tRPC or similar) and typed contracts between frontend and backend Testing as a habit: Vitest, JSDom or comparable tooling Comfortable in a Unix environment (Linux or macOS), with Git, branches and PRs You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can explain the trade-offs You work well with little oversight and ship in small, frequent steps Fluent English, written and spoken You're in Berlin or willing to move, and you're in our office 2 to 3 days a week How we work Hybrid in Berlin. You're in the office 2 to 3 days a week. That's fixed. The rest of the week you work from wherever you like. Short paths. You talk to the founders directly, most decisions take one call. Real ownership. The frontend is yours to shape, and you'll set many of the standards the team builds on. Real impact. Your work runs in buildings across Germany and makes energy use visible where people live. Room to grow with the company as the engineering team gets bigger. Your next steps If you match most of these requirements and are ready to help digitize the building sector, we encourage you to apply. You will join a growing team where your work directly shapes the future of energy management in real estate. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software engineer, AI model supply chain and package security
description: We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile. When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models. The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role. The work Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently. You'll work on two related areas. Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people. AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes: A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robots A model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOM Delta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small change Compression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and network Managing models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them back Testing the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model quality A lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found. What we're looking for You don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right. Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switch Interest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formats Familiarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similar Basic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guarantee You like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work out You live in Berlin or are willing to move here It's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required. What we offer You'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and RoboStack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. We help with relocation within the EU. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
description: Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. title: Logistics Operations Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>You will work closely with Cloudflare's Infrastructure team as well as with external vendors and partners to support the rapid growth and maintenance of our data center infrastructure. You will be responsible for coordinating the distribution and delivery of data center hardware to and from our data centers within the region. You will participate in the development and implementation of consistent processes and performance measurements, utilizing business intelligence and AI tools.</p> <p>You will support the team globally on infrastructure projects such as data center expansions, hardware renewals, reverse logistics and spare parts fulfillment. </p> <p>This is a role that requires understanding of warehousing, transportation, and requires experience with data analysis and AI tools. You will support our partners within a complex and fast moving global supply chain.</p> <p>This is a highly collaborative position that will require coordinating with:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Warehousing providers, freight forwarders, importer of record partners, customs brokers and data center partners to plan and execute on the delivery of data center hardware.</p> </li> <li> <p>External vendors including hardware manufacturers, rack integrators and contract vendors, across time zones, in support of our 200+ and growing data center locations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Internal teams such as Data Center Engineering, Capacity Planning, Trade Compliance, Hardware Sourcing, and Procurement.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Post-secondary degree in a technical or business management field.</p> </li> <li> <p>A minimum of 3 years of experience working with global supply chains and logistics is necessary.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to be proactive with ability to learn fast and execute on multiple tasks simultaneously.</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to recognize areas for improvements in operational processes in a rapidly changing environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Python, LLM usage and AI tooling experience.</p> </li> <li> <p>Possess strong verbal and written communication skills, problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Desirable, but not required:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Experience supporting data centers or other Networking/IT hardware and infrastructure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Multi-lingual, preferably in Spanish.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Solutions Architect - Search Specialist
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role</strong></h3> <p>At Elastic, we're revolutionizing the search and data analytics space. We're pioneers in the integration of Gen AI, powerful retrieval models like ELSER, and cutting-edge semantic search technologies like vector search, empowering businesses to unlock unprecedented insights and experiences.</p> <p>As a Search Solutions Architect, you'll be at the forefront of this transformative journey. You'll play a pivotal role in designing and deploying innovative solutions that leverage the combined power of these technologies, helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data. Your work will directly influence the success of organizations worldwide, helping them unlock new opportunities and make insightful decisions. </p> <p>Are you ready to join the Elastic Revolution and be a pioneer in the next generation of Search powered AI? Apply now and embark on this exciting journey with us! We're eager to welcome you to a team that's shaping the future and helping organizations unlock the full potential of their data.</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Architect next-generation search solutions: Design and implement cutting-edge solutions utilizing Elastic's latest advancements in AI, semantic search, and vector search, including RAG, vector databases, and other emerging technologies.</li> <li>Harness the power of ELSER: Enable organizations to achieve unparalleled accuracy and efficiency in their search queries and data retrieval processes, leveraging the capabilities of the Elastic Learned Sparse Encoder.</li> <li>Unlock the potential of vector search: Implement powerful vector search algorithms and create high-dimensional vector representations of data, allowing users to find the information they need even with imprecise queries.</li> <li>Deliver compelling proof-of-concept (POC) projects: Showcase the combined value of AI, semantic search, vector search, and ELSER through successful POCs, demonstrating the potential for improved search relevance, user experience, and decision-making.</li> <li>Become a thought leader and evangelize our vision: Share your expertise through presentations, blog posts, and other channels, positioning Elastic as the leader in AI-powered search and semantic data exploration.</li> <li>Cultivate a collaborative environment within the Solutions Architecture team and across departments, promoting knowledge sharing and driving continuous improvement.</li> <li>Collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, data scientists, and industry experts who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of search and AI-powered solutions.</li> <li>Continuously learn and explore the ever-evolving landscapes of AI, semantic search, vector search, and related technologies, ensuring your solutions are always at the forefront of innovation. We provide access to world-class training programs and cutting-edge technology.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in designing and architecting enterprise-level search solutions.</li> <li>Deep understanding of AI and semantic search technologies, with a focus on RAG, vector search, and NLP.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging ecosystem technologies and how they interoperate like Hugging Face, Langchain, etc.</li> <li>Solid knowledge of ELSER's architecture and other models within the Hugging Face ecosystem.</li> <li>Experience with vector databases and other emerging data storage solutions.</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills, able to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. title: Associate Director/ Director, Sales Force Effectiveness, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Mavericks Wanted</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on</span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible. </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto"> </span> <br><span data-contrast="auto">Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p></div><p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>You will report to the Senior Director Commercial Excellence, International and work closely with country General Managers, International commercial functional leads, IT, and Medical Affairs to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients with genetic diseases and genetically driven cancers. This newly created role sits where International’s commercial strategy turns into field execution. Your primary purpose will be to build and own Sales Force Effectiveness, the International CRM platform, and key account management from the ground up, with a focus on launch readiness and flawless field execution across International markets. This role requires effective collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality execution and impact. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in sales force effectiveness, CRM, and commercial operations with strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.</p> <p><strong><u>Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead segmentation and targeting, sales force sizing and territory design as the International footprint grows, embedding data-driven insights into resource allocation, and build the Sales Force Effectiveness performance framework, including KPIs, dashboards, and regular reporting</li> <li>Design, implement, and administer sales incentive plans in close partnership with Finance, HR, Legal, and Compliance</li> <li>Lead the International CRM build and implementation, partnering with IT to deploy a lean, harmonized, fit-for-purpose Veeva Vault solution across markets, and own CRM operations, data stewardship, and adoption through training and change management</li> <li>Design AI-enabled field execution support, including next best action insights and recommendations</li> <li>Develop and implement the strategic account planning model and build key account management capability in the field, partnering with Medical Affairs and Market Access to expand access at account level</li> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor to country General Managers and International functional leads on SFE, CRM, and account management, and support omnichannel customer engagement in partnership with the Customer Engagement Lead</li> <li>Support countries building up for launch with SFE, CRM, and field deployment readiness, ensure compliance with regional and local regulations, and build the International Sales Force Effectiveness function from the ground up</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Where You’ll Work  </u></strong></p> <p>This is an office-based role in our Zug, Switzerland office, requiring in-office collaboration 2-3x per week, with additional travel of up to 20% across International markets to support country teams and launch readiness</p> <p><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>BA or BS in Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; MBA or other advanced degree/certification preferred</li> <li>10+ years of experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotech industry, including sales force effectiveness, sales operations, or commercial excellence, and experience directly supporting one or more product launches (specialty or rare disease strongly preferred)</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of designing and deploying sales force effectiveness frameworks across multiple markets, experience leading a CRM implementation or major platform roll-out, and experience designing and administering incentive compensation plans</li> <li>Strong analytical and data skills, including advanced Excel and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to influence and align senior stakeholders, including country General Managers, without direct authority</li> <li>Prior exposure to multiple geographies strongly preferred, with deep expertise in at least one region required</li> <li>Fluency in English required; ability to travel up to 20%</li> </ul> <p><em>T</em><em>his position is available at Associate Director or Director level, will be determined by the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong><u>Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible</u></strong></p> <p>We have high expectations for our team members. We make sure those working hard for patients are rewarded and cared for in return.</p> <ul> <li>Market leading compensation</li> <li>Hybrid work model - we value your flexibility in how you work, but encourage time in the office to strengthen our culture, collaboration, and sense of community</li> <li>We provide career development through regular feedback, continuous education and professional development programs</li> <li>We celebrate strong performance with financial rewards, peer-to-peer recognition, and growth opportunities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>As a global company, our comprehensive benefits may vary based on location.  <span data-contrast="auto">We have high expectations for our team members. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.</span></span></div> </li> <li class="public-DraftStyleDefault-unorderedListItem public-DraftStyleDefault-depth0 public-DraftStyleDefault-listLTR" data-block="true" data-editor="pi9d" data-offset-key="evnoe-0-0"> <div class="public-DraftStyleDefault-block public-DraftStyleDefault-ltr" data-offset-key="evnoe-0-0"><span data-offset-key="evnoe-0-0"><span data-text="true">Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. title: Director, International Delivery Management - Professional Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>What is The Role</strong></p> <p>Elastic is looking for an exceptional delivery consulting leader — someone who has built and run international delivery organisations, understands how to drive bookings growth and revenue expansion inside complex enterprise accounts, and can operate at the highest levels of client engagement while simultaneously leading and transforming a mid-sized, globally distributed team.</p> <p>You will own the international Delivery Management function across Elastic Professional Services — leading the team, driving the transformation, and acting as the senior client presence on our most strategic engagements. You will be accountable for both the operational health of the delivery organisation and the commercial outcomes it generates: bookings, revenue, and margin across EMEA and APJ.</p> <p><em>Delivery excellence is your foundation. Commercial growth is your north star. Building the team that industrialises both — and equips it for an AI-enabled future — is your legacy.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing </strong></p> <p><strong>International Delivery Organisation — EMEA & APJ</strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>Own and lead the international Delivery Management function</strong>  a team of ~15 Delivery Managers today, distributed across global delivery hubs in EMEA and APJ — with a clear mandate and expectation to scale substantially through 2027 and 2028 as the practice grows and demand accelerates across both regions.</p> <p><strong>▸  Drive a team transformation </strong>— reframing how Delivery Managers operate, shifting from project execution to outcome-led consulting, equipping the team to hold more strategic client conversations and drive greater account value.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Champion and drive the adoption of Fixed Price engagement models</strong>  leading the organisation through the commercial, contractual, and delivery discipline required to scope, price, and execute fixed-price engagements with confidence, especially with platform migrations — protecting margin while driving predictable, high-quality client outcomes.</p> <p>▸  Build a dual-mode delivery capability that operates with excellence across two distinct motions:</p> <p><strong>①  Packaged Solutions</strong>  —  fast, repeatable, industrialised delivery of high-value outcome-based offerings at scale — anchored in Fixed Price commercial models.</p> <p><strong>②  Transformative Engagements</strong>  —  large, complex migrations and solution delivery that require senior delivery governance, deep client partnership, and adaptive programme leadership.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Lead the integration of AI into the Delivery Management function</strong>  identifying and embedding AI-powered tools and practices that improve team productivity, sharpen delivery insight, and — critically — enrich the client experience by enabling more proactive, personalised, and higher-value engagement throughout the delivery lifecycle.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Design and embed delivery standards, frameworks, and tooling</strong> — including AI-augmented capabilities — that enable the team to scale both delivery modes without sacrificing quality or client outcomes.</p> <p><strong>▸  Act as a player-coach</strong> — maintaining direct governance oversight on the most complex or at-risk international engagements, intervening and course-correcting where needed.</p> <p><strong>▸  Build a coaching and development culture within the team</strong> — raising the floor on delivery craft and the ceiling on consulting commerciality across every region working closely with the Regional Services Directors, to generate new opportunities on the back of outstanding delivery. </p> <p><strong>Financial Leadership & Commercial Growth</strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>Own financial accountability across the international delivery portfolio</strong>  driving consulting bookings growth from delivery, maximising revenue realisation from engagements, and actively improving delivery margin through disciplined engagement management, Fixed Price adoption, and commercial rigour.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Grow the consulting footprint</strong> within a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts across EMEA and APJ, driving land-and-expand value outcomes in close partnership with regional Sales organisations.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Build and sustain C-level and VP-level executive relationships</strong> that extend beyond the project — becoming the trusted advisor clients return to for their most important decisions.</p> <p>▸ <strong> Develop compelling value narratives</strong> that articulate the value of engaging Elastic's consulting services, influencing renewal, expansion, and new commercial commitments.</p> <p>▸ <strong> Partner with Regional Services Directors on pipeline development</strong> — acting as a senior consulting delivery voice in pre-sales conversations, solution framing, and commercial structuring including Fixed Price proposals.</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <p>▸  Serve as the connective tissue between Consulting, Sales, Customer Success, and Product when driving an engagement — ensuring a unified client experience and shared accountability for outcomes across EMEA and APJ.</p> <p>▸  Contribute to the evolution of Elastic's delivery consulting go-to-market: methodology design, packaged solution development, delivery model innovation, AI-enabled tooling, and commercial frameworks.</p> <p>▸  Represent Elastic Professional Services at the senior leadership level — internally and externally — with the credibility and presence to influence how the organisation grows internationally.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You Bring </strong></p> <p>▸  <strong>International enterprise leadership</strong>  Proven track record building and leading delivery teams across EMEA and/or APJ. You understand how regional culture, client expectations, and hub-based delivery dynamics shape outcomes.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Fixed Price engagement expertise</strong>  You have designed, sold, and delivered Fixed Price consulting engagements at scale. You understand the scoping rigour, risk management, and delivery discipline required to make this model work — and you have driven its adoption across a delivery organisation.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Financial accountability</strong>  You have owned a P&L or delivery portfolio with direct accountability for bookings, revenue, and margin — and you have a track record of improving all three.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Dual-mode delivery experience</strong>  You have designed and operated delivery models that handle both high-velocity repeatable engagements and complex, multi-stakeholder transformations — simultaneously.</p> <p>▸  <strong>AI fluency in a delivery context</strong>  You have a clear point of view on how AI can transform delivery management and client engagement — and you have practical experience applying AI tools to improve team effectiveness, delivery quality, or customer outcomes.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Commercial acumen</strong>  You have expanded client accounts, shaped SOWs, and driven revenue growth from within a delivery or consulting organisation. You know how value conversations are won.</p> <p>▸  <strong>Executive presence</strong>  You are credible at the C-suite level across multiple geographies. You have built relationships that outlast individual projects and turned delivery success into long-term strategic partnership.</p> <p>▸  <strong>People leadership at scale</strong>  You have led and transformed mid-to-large delivery teams, building coaching cultures that raise performance and commerciality across a distributed, multi-timezone workforce.</p> <p>▸  <strong>12+ years</strong>  in management consulting, professional services, or enterprise SaaS delivery leadership — with meaningful time spent in both client-facing growth roles and people/org leadership.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Bonus Points </strong></p> <p>▸  Experience industrialising packaged service offerings — creating repeatable, Fixed Price delivery motions from complex, bespoke prior engagements.</p> <p>▸  Hands-on experience deploying AI tools within a professional services or consulting delivery environment.</p> <p>▸  Background spanning pre-sales/solutioning and post-sales delivery — the full consulting lifecycle.</p> <p>▸  Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g. Elastic, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Databricks) in a consulting or professional services capacity.</p> <p>▸  Agile and hybrid delivery framework fluency in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments, but with extensive experience of platform migrations / tools consolidation.</p> <p>▸  Certifications (PMP, CSM, or equivalent) are valued, though leadership track record and client outcomes matter more.</p> <p> </p> <p>Elastic's Professional Services organisation is at an inflection point internationally. We are scaling a delivery team across EMEA and APJ — with significant headcount growth expected through 2027 and 2028 — building a dual-mode delivery capability, shifting to Fixed Price engagement models, embedding AI into how we deliver and engage clients, and growing a client base that demands senior, outcome-focused leadership. All at once.</p> <p> </p> <p>This role carries real financial weight and a real transformation mandate. You will have the authority to reshape how an international team operates, the commercial platform to build lasting client partnerships across two major regions, and the executive visibility to influence how Elastic goes to market with its consulting capability globally.</p> <p> </p> <p>If you have built delivery organisations, owned the numbers, led through transformation, embraced AI as a genuine force multiplier, and made Fixed Price work where others haven't — and you are looking for a role where all of it matters — this is it.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our Peo

title: Senior Value Engineer - Supply Chain
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p>The position of the <strong>Senior Value Engineer</strong> is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>You are spearheading our mission of data-driven business transformation with our customers. You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. You are our customers' trusted advisor and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize significant value using Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.</p> <p><strong>The work you’ll do:</strong><strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Identify & Frame Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases</li> <li>Build demos and business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to win new customers </li> <li>Undertake Value Assessments or Proof-of-Value Projects and communicate the value opportunity and strategic roadmap to C-Level executive</li> </ul> <p><strong>Realize Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Facilitate business value workshops and use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement</li> <li>Derive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives</li> <li>Present results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale Value</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for the end-to-end customer value journey, landing, expanding, adoption and renewing</li> <li>Build a strategic expansion roadmap for customers embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization and therefore drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>The qualifications you need:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Live for Customer Value: </strong>Experience in an analytical role with the objective to demonstrate or secure value through business data analysis, business process improvement and respective Software deployment. Ideally in a customer-facing role in Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy. Alternatively in an Inhouse role (e.g. Center of Excellence for Data Mining / Analytics / Intelligence) within an Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: </strong>Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP),  experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Knowledge of <strong>Python</strong> and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.</p> <p><strong>Process Improvement & Value Realization: </strong>Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures,  being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value</p> <p><strong>Project Management: </strong>Experience in planning and managing project scopes, expectations and timelines. You will manage multiple projects across your aligned accounts that will be at different parts of the value journey. Also, you will leverage partners from the Celonis Ecosystem wherever possible.</p> <p><strong>Executive Stakeholder Management: </strong>Experience in preparing and communicating (value) roadmaps and results to stakeholders and management, both internally and externally. Excellent communication and presentation skills.</p> <p><strong>Business Domain Expertise: </strong>Understanding of the Finance and/or Supply Chain domain as well as strategic transformation initiatives (e.g. Shared Services Transformation or System Transformation)</p> <p><strong>Industry Expertise: </strong>Ideally expertise in Aviation/Logistics/Transportation and the ability to develop a deep understanding of industry trends and strategic opportunities  <strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Degree: </strong>In Technology & Management, Industrial/Business Engineering, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics or a comparable degree program</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Support Group</strong></h2> <p>As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. </p> <p>During the years we’ve invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it’s the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations’ quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.</p> <h2><strong>About the Support Analytics Team</strong></h2> <p>Our Support Analytics team’s main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 </p> <p>You’ll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.</p> <p>Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the <strong>Workforce Management (WFM) </strong>team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>Required:</p> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of experience</strong> in a data science or analytics position</li> <li>Experience building<strong> forecasting models and time series analysis</strong> (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)</li> <li>Experience in<strong> Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis</strong></li> <li>Deep knowledge of statistical packages in <strong>Python or R</strong></li> <li>Proficiency in writing structured and efficient<strong> SQL queries</strong> for large data sets</li> <li>Ability to<strong> influence and advise senior stakeholders </strong>Good to have:</li> <li>Experience using ML for forecasting</li> <li>Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform</li> <li>Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. description: <p class="isSelectedEnd"></p> <h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Description de l'équipe</h2> <p>SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. La personne retenue dirigera et développera une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en assurant personnellement des acquisitions dans un premier temps tout en construisant la structure, la culture et le modèle de coaching qui porteront la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché</p> </li> <li> <p>Porter les objectifs d'acquisition de revenus de la région, piloter le portefeuille de marchands acquis et le développer par la vente croisée et la montée en gamme</p> </li> <li> <p>Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain</p> </li> <li> <p>Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes</p> </li> <li> <p>Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable</p> </li> <li> <p>Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer</p> </li> <li> <p>Solide connaissance des services aux marchands, des paiements, des systèmes de point de vente ou de la vente auprès des PME, par exemple dans l'hôtellerie ou le voyage</p> </li> <li> <p>Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées</p> </li> <li> <p>Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp</h2> <p>🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp</p> <h2>À propos de SumUp</h2> <p>Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.</p> <p>Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.</p> <p>Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://youtu.be/9DG64C3moeQ?si=YpcWuBNBTOQPzeLI" target="_blank">notre équipe diversifiée</a> de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/culture/" target="_blank">Nos valeurs fondamentales</a> constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nos différences font notre unicité et notre force, à mesure que nous œuvrons à créer un environnement où chacun se sent à sa place et soutenu, quelle que soit son identité.</p> <p>SumUp est fier d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, recherchant et accueillant activement la diversité au sein de ses équipes. Notre engagement va au delà du recrutement pour créer un lieu de travail sûr et respectueux, où toute forme de harcèlement est strictement interdite. Découvrez-en davantage sur notre culture et nos opportunités sur notre <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/" target="_blank">site carrières</a>, et suivez notre actualité sur <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/sumup/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a>, <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.instagram.com/insidesumup/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> et <a class="text-primary underline cursor-pointer" href="https://www.tiktok.com/@insidesumup" target="_blank">TikTok</a>.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd"></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) indépendant
description: <h1>Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) </h1> <p>Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées</p> <h2>À propos de l’opportunité</h2> <p>Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.</p> <p>En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li> <p>Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</p> </li> <li> <p>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</p> </li> <li> <p>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</p> </li> <li> <p>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</p> </li> <li> <p>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.</p> </li> <li> <p>Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.</p> </li> <li> <p>La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Atouts</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.</p> <h2>Rémunération</h2> <p>Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.</p> <p>Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :</p> <ul> <li> <p>Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.</p> </li> <li> <p>Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.</p> </li> <li> <p>Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.</p> </li> <li> <p>Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.</p> </li> </ul> <p>Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.</p> <p>Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.</p> <h2>Formation et accompagnement</h2> <p>Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.</p> <p>Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.</p> <p>Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technical Site Manager (m/w/d) - Maintenance Operations & Continuous Improvement
description: <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Unsere Fulfilment Center gehören zu den modernsten ihrer Art und beliefern täglich tausende Haushalte mit frischen Lebensmitteln. Als nächstes wollen wir im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) unser brandneues hybrides Fulfilment Center öffnen. Falkensee gehört zu den ersten Standorten, an denen wir die Instandhaltung unserer automatisierten Anlagen intern aufbauen, statt vollständig auszulagern. Als Technical Site Manager (m/w/d) - Maintenance Operations & Continuous Improvement übernimmst du den Aufbau, die strategische Verantwortung für die Performance und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Material-Handling-Anlagen und Instandhaltungsprozesse am Standort.</p> <p>Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den automatisierten und manuellen Prozessen im Fulfilment Center, den operativen Teams, deinem Maintenance Team, unseren Engineering- und Analytics-Teams sowie externen Partnern.
