This is an individual-contributor role; people-management experience is not required.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use</strong></p> <ul> <li>Browser engine: Chromium and C++.</li> <li>Systems programming: Rust.</li> <li>Distributed services and orchestration: Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Nomad, and Consul.</li> <li>Remote rendering and streaming: WebRTC and Skia.</li> <li>Browser client: TypeScript, WebAssembly, and WebGL.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you will do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex, multi-component initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation, staged rollout, and measurable production outcomes.</li> <li>Design and implement changes in our Chromium-based C++ browser and the distributed services and systems components supporting remote browsing, working across Go, Rust, and TypeScript.</li> <li>Make and explain architectural trade-offs across latency, availability, resource efficiency, security boundaries, and operational complexity.</li> <li>Investigate difficult cross-layer failures and performance bottlenecks, distinguishing browser, host, network, and control-plane causes.</li> <li>Improve resilience, capacity management, observability, and release safety; define success metrics and validate results.</li> <li>Coordinate work with partner teams, surface dependencies and risks early, and guide delivery through ambiguity.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and raise the quality of code reviews, design reviews, testing, documentation, and operational practices.</li> <li>Participate in the team’s production on-call rotation after onboarding, lead technical incident investigations as needed, and drive durable corrective actions.</li> </ul> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong production C++ proficiency, including memory and resource ownership, concurrency, and debugging in substantial codebases.</li> <li>A track record of independently leading complex systems or distributed-service improvements across multiple components, from an unclear problem to a reliable production outcome.</li> <li>Strong Linux/UNIX and networking fundamentals, with experience diagnosing correctness, latency, and resource-consumption issues using profiling and operational evidence.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating distributed systems, with sound judgment about service boundaries, data partitioning, consistency, timeouts and retries, backpressure, capacity limits, and recovery from partial failures.</li> <li>Experience designing safe rollout and recovery strategies and maintaining production software over its lifecycle.</li> <li>Ability to communicate trade-offs clearly, align stakeholders, mentor teammates, and improve engineering practices through constructive feedback.</li> <li>A willingness to work across C++, Rust, Go, and TypeScript and learn unfamiliar parts of the stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>These are preferred qualifications, not prerequisites. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Infrastructure & SRE Background:</strong> Solid experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, or production engineering, with a track record of running and scaling large-scale production systems.</li> <li><strong>Capacity & Fleet Operations:</strong> Practical experience bringing server capacity online, encompassing provisioning, imaging, configuration management, and fleet-scale lifecycle management.</li> <li><strong>Hardware Fluency:</strong> Familiarity with server hardware, firmware, BMC/IPMI/Redfish, and diagnostics. Ability to set validation standards, triage issues remotely, and partner with on-site technicians. Experience with GPUs or specialized accelerators is a plus.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Networking:</strong> Strong understanding of Linux systems and core networking principles (TCP/IP, BGP, DNS, load balancing, and data center topologies).</li> <li><strong>Automation & Development:</strong> Proficiency in languages such as Go, Python, or Rust, along with experience using infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Salt).</li> <li><strong>Production Ownership:</strong> Experience supporting mission-critical services, including on-call rotations, incident response, SLO management, and reliability engineering.</li> <li><strong>Observability:</strong> Familiarity with monitoring, metrics, and logging frameworks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse) to maintain system health proactively.</li> <li><strong>Containers & Orchestration:</strong> Exposure to Kubernetes or similar platforms and workload scheduling on newly provisioned capacity.</li> <li><strong>AI-Augmented Workflows:</strong> Interest or experience in leveraging modern AI tools to streamline automation, debugging, and documentation.</li> <li><strong>Program-Level Coordination:</strong> Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, multi-team delivery efforts across regions and time zones with clear communication and alignment.</li> <li><strong>Proactive title: Recruiting Coordinator, EMEA
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission. We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome. COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily GTM roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly. BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results NICE TO HAVES: - Experience supporting both GTM roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description: <p>ANINE BING is looking for a <strong>Senior FP&A Analyst</strong> to join our <strong>Finance</strong> team based in <strong>Paris</strong>.</p> <p>As a senior member of our Paris HQ Finance team, the Senior FP&A Analyst holds the full view of the company P&L, from net sales to EBITDA, across all channels and regions. The role combines ownership of the planning and reporting cycles with hands-on business partnering, and plays a central part in structuring our FP&A processes as the brand scales internationally.</p> <p>We're looking for a rigorous, process-oriented finance professional with a strong retail background and a sharp understanding of margin mechanics. You are comfortable owning the numbers end to end and challenging the business on what drives them.</p> <p>This is a <strong>full-time permanent position (CDI)</strong> based at our <strong>Paris HQ</strong> (<em>with 4 days per week in the office and 1 day of remote work possible</em>). The role reports to the <strong>Head of Finance</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities Include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Full P&L ownership:</strong> own the company-wide P&L view, from net sales through gross margin, store contribution and operating expenses down to EBITDA, consolidated across retail, e-commerce and wholesale, and across the US, Europe and Asia. Act as the go-to reference on P&L performance and its drivers for the Head of Finance and the leadership team.</li> <li><strong>Budgeting & forecasting:</strong> lead the annual budget, monthly reforecasts and long-range plan. Own the planning calendar, key assumptions and models, and consolidate inputs from regional and functional stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Margin management:</strong> own margin analysis at every level (channel, market, category, collection, SKU), including markdowns, promotions, cost of goods, freight, duties, FX and inventory provisions. Build margin bridges, explain variances and drive recommendations on pricing and markdown strategy.</li> <li><strong>Monthly close & reporting:</strong> own the FP&A month-end close and the global management reporting package (actuals vs. budget, forecast and prior year, variance commentary, KPI dashboards). Work with Accounting to ensure management and statutory figures reconcile.</li> <li><strong>Business partnering:</strong> serve as finance partner to Retail, E-Commerce, Wholesale, Merchandising and Supply Chain leaders on store P&Ls, inventory productivity and open-to-buy, pricing, promotional plans, and business cases for store openings and market entries.</li> <li><strong>Processes & controls:</strong> design, document and continuously improve FP&A processes, templates, review controls and data standards. Drive reporting automation across the finance stack (NetSuite, Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools) in coordination with Accounting and IT.</li> <li><strong>Leadership support:</strong> prepare materials for executive and board reviews and lead ad hoc analyses requested by the CFO and the Head of Finance. Review and guide the work of junior team members.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>5–7 years of experience</strong> in FP&A, controlling or financial planning, with significant exposure to a company-wide or business-unit scope.</li> <li><strong>Retail experience is mandatory:</strong> proven experience in a retail or fashion company with a store network and multi-channel model, and a solid command of store economics, seasonality, markdowns, inventory and open-to-buy.</li> <li><strong>Full P&L vision:</strong> hands-on experience owning or co-owning a full P&L, from top line to EBITDA, including consolidation across channels or countries.</li> <li><strong>Strong margin expertise:</strong> gross margin building blocks, markdown and promotional impact, landed cost, inventory valuation and provisions, with the ability to explain margin drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Rigorous and process-oriented:</strong> a track record of building or improving planning, closing and reporting processes, with reliable delivery against deadlines.</li> <li>Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and financial modeling skills; experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a plus) and a BI or reporting tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau or equivalent).</li> <li>Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.</li> <li>Fluent English required (global scope, US HQ, international teams); professional proficiency in French preferred.</li> <li>Strong communication skills: able to turn complex analyses into concise, decision-oriented messages and to challenge senior operational stakeholders with confidence</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits & Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>At ANINE BING Paris, we combine creative ambition with a people-first culture. Expect generous time off (including RTT), flexible work, exclusive discounts on our collections, and private sales access — so you can live the brand as much as you build it.</li> <li><strong>Style Perks: </strong>enjoy a generous employee discount and seasonal wardrobe allotments — so you can live the brand, not just represent it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Working at ANINE BING</strong></p> <p>ANINE BING seeks to empower its employees by providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Diversity and inclusion is critical to our success as a global brand, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.</p> <p><strong>More about ANINE BING</strong></p> <p>ANINE BING is a Los Angeles-based fashion house founded in 2012 that blends elements of Scandinavian simplicity with American energy to offer modern wardrobe essentials for women seeking a timeless yet rebellious approach to everyday style. Since its launch, ANINE BING has evolved into a global brand, available in over 90 countries with a growing network of brick-and-mortar retail stores in key cities worldwide.</p> <p>Powered by a global team of over 250 employees, ANINE BING is headquartered in Los Angeles and Paris, with additional offices in New York and Shanghai.</p> <p><strong>About Our Paris HQ</strong></p> <p>Located just off the Champs-Élysées, our Paris headquarters at 1 Rue François 1er is a cornerstone of our international growth. As the home of our Product teams and other key functions, this space reflects our commitment to creativity, collaboration, and global perspective. As we continue to grow across Europe, our Paris office plays a central role in shaping the future of our brand.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Manager – E-Commerce Web Upper Funnel [CDI] (f/m/d)
description: <h2><strong>Staff Product Manager – E-Commerce Web Upper Funnel [CDI] (f/m/d)</strong></h2> <p><strong>Localisation :</strong> Paris ou Lille, France</p> <p><strong>Équipe :</strong> Decathlon E-Commerce Web – Périmètre Upper Funnel</p> <h3><strong>À propos de l'équipe</strong></h3> <p>Au cœur de l'écosystème digital mondial de Decathlon, notre équipe <strong>E-Commerce Web</strong> façonne la destination en ligne de millions de passionné·es de sport à travers le monde. Notre mission est de guider de manière fluide chaque utilisateur de l'inspiration jusqu'à l'intention d'achat.</p> <p>Rejoindre cette organisation Produit Web à fort trafic, c'est évoluer à très grande échelle, où la vitesse, l'excellence de la découverte, le SEO, la monétisation ciblée et les parcours personnalisés de nouvelle génération génèrent notre impact business quotidien.</p> <h3><strong>TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION</strong></h3> <p>En tant que <strong>Staff Product Manager – Upper Funnel</strong>, tu apporteras la vision stratégique, l'architecture fonctionnelle et le leadership produit nécessaires pour faire passer l'expérience de découverte et d'exploration de notre plateforme web à l'échelle supérieure. En toute autonomie, tu traiteras des enjeux complexes : performance de la recherche, structuration du catalogue, intégration du Retail Media et virages technologiques de l'IA (interfaces conversationnelles, agents autonomes).</p> <p>Tes responsabilités s'articulent autour de 4 piliers stratégiques :</p> <h4><strong>1. Alignement stratégique, gestion des parties prenantes & Vision Upper Funnel</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Porter la vision globale de la découverte & de l'engagement</strong> : Définir et piloter la feuille de route stratégique des points de contact de l'Upper Funnel (Page d'accueil, Pages catégories/listes, Moteur de recherche, Arborescence/Taxonomie, Emplacements publicitaires Retail Media, Assistants conversationnels et Hubs d'inspiration).</li> <li><strong>Alignement exécuteur & transversal</strong> : Collaborer étroitement avec la direction business globale, les responsables merchandising, les spécialistes SEO, les équipes de monétisation Retail Media et la tech IA pour aligner l'organisation sur les évolutions majeures de la plateforme.</li> <li><strong>Pilotage des métriques macro & performance du funnel</strong> : Suivre et optimiser les métriques clés tout au long du parcours : Trafic organique/direct, CTR de la recherche, profondeur de navigation, taux d'engagement conversationnel, rendement publicitaire (eCPM), taux de rebond, CTR vers les fiches produits (PDP) et conversion globale du haut de funnel.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>2. Architecture fonctionnelle & Orchestration de l'écosystème Web</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Architecte Fonctionnel·le Principal·e</strong> : Définir la répartition des périmètres entre les squads web (<em>Search & Conversational Discovery, Taxonomy & Merchandising, Personalization/Recommendations, Retail Media & Sponsored Listings</em>) afin d'éliminer les frictions et les doublons.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration étroite en Triade</strong> : Travailler en synergie avec les Staff/Principal Web Engineers et les Staff UX/UI Designers pour aligner la performance frontend (Core Web Vitals), le Design System web, l'architecture micro-frontend, les composants UI conversationnels et les API de recherche/ad-serving.</li> <li><strong>Parcours omnicanal & passage de relais fluide</strong> : Garantir des transitions fluides depuis les canaux d'acquisition externes vers l'Upper Funnel web, en équilibrant la découverte organique, l'assistance conversationnelle/agentique et les inventaires sponsorisés, tout en facilitant le passage vers le bas de funnel (PDP, Panier & Checkout).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>3. Sparring stratégique & De-risking Produit</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Partenaire et mentor stratégique</strong> : Conseiller les Group Product Managers (GPM) et Product Managers (PM) du domaine E-Commerce web pour naviguer au sein des algorithmes de recherche complexes, des architectures d'agents LLM, des intégrations d'ad-servers et des contraintes web à très fort volume.</li> <li><strong>Stratégies de réduction des risques (De-risking)</strong> : Formuler et exécuter des boucles de validation rapides sur les concepts à forte incertitude (recherche visuelle/vocale, conseillers produits conversationnels, réapprovisionnement/bundles agentiques, placements sponsorisés).</li> <li><strong>Expérimentation continue à grande échelle</strong> : Piloter des stratégies de A/B testing et tests multivariés à fort trafic, en équilibrant l'intensité des interactions conversationnelles et la pression publicitaire face à la conversion organique (frameworks CRO, Opportunity Solution Trees - OST).</li> </ul> <h4><strong>4. Élévation de la culture & des capacités Web modernes</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Leadership IA, Agentique & Monétisation</strong> : Promouvoir l'adoption des solutions IA cloud-natives (ex: Google Vertex AI), des frameworks conversationnels, des modes d'achat agentiques et des fonctionnalités Retail Media pour amplifier à la fois l'expérience utilisateur et les revenus de la plateforme.</li> technique web, décisions guidées par la donnée).</li> <li><strong>Multiplicateur d'impact</strong> : Élever le niveau collectif de l'organisation Produit en tant que leader d'opinion, sans rôle de management hiérarchique direct.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>CE QUE TU APPORTES</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Expérience E-Commerce Web à échelle (7 ans+)</strong> : Solide parcours en Product Management dans la mise à l'échelle de plateformes e-commerce web à fort trafic (Upper Funnel, Search, Merchandising ou Navigation).</li> <li><strong>Expertise Upper Funnel & SEO</strong> : Compréhension title: Senior Named Account Executive (Majors), Sydney
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney<br></strong></p> <hr> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.</p> <p>The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p> <p>Our Enterprise team specifically helps marquee Australian corporations solve complex technical challenges while protecting their critical digital infrastructure, customer data, and online experiences.</p> <p>As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will lead Cloudflare’s strategic engagement for a portfolio of premier NSW-headquartered enterprise accounts across Financial Services, Healthcare, Media, and Digital Tech leaders. In this role, you will drive adoption of the Cloudflare platform across Security, Performance, Zero Trust, and AI infrastructure, positioning Cloudflare as a foundational pillar for digital transformation and enterprise resilience.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Relationship Management: </strong>Build and nurture deep, executive-level relationships across target named accounts, navigating complex organizational structures to establish trusted advisor status with C-suite and technology leaders</li> <li><strong>Territory Leadership:</strong> Formulate and lead the engagement strategy across your assigned NSW enterprise portfolio, driving adoption of Cloudflare’s core solutions across Cloud SaaS, Zero Trust, Network Security, and AI enablement.</li> <li><strong>Partner Ecosystem Engagement:</strong> Collaborate with strategic channel partners, Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), and cloud ecosystem partners to extend Cloudflare’s reach, influence, and co-selling impact within target accounts.</li> <li><strong>Business Development & Execution: </strong>Proactively identify and qualify high-impact enterprise opportunities, leveraging AI-assisted research and cross-functional teams to drive multi-million-dollar transformational outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Account Strategy & Operational Rigor: </strong>Execute comprehensive multi-year account plans while maintaining high standards in forecasting accuracy, pipeline hygiene, and deal qualification.</li> <li><strong>Full Lifecycle Collaboration:</strong> Partner with Customer Engineers, Customer Success, and Professional Services to ensure successful deployment, value realization, and platform expansion through to renewal.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Leadership:</strong> Share industry insights, competitive intelligence, and enterprise deal strategies across the ANZ team, actively mentoring peers to elevate collective performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of meeting and exceeding complex B2B enterprise software or SaaS sales quotas in high-growth technology environment</li> <li>Deep understanding of the NSW enterprise market, with experience navigating complex commercial procurement, legal, and risk governance processes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to build executive relationships (CIO, CISO, CTO, Head of Infrastructure) and close multi-year enterprise agreements.</li> <li>Strong technical aptitude with the ability to translate complex cloud, network, Zero Trust, SASE, and AI infrastructure concepts into strategic business outcomes for senior leadership.</li> <li>High proficiency in leveraging modern sales tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate pipeline generation, deal strategy, and account research.</li> <li>Alignment with Cloudflare’s core values: Principled, Curious, and Transparent</li> <li>Existing network and familiarity within target accounts across Financial Services, Media, Healthcare, or Technology (e.g., ANZ Bank, Bendigo and Adelaide Bank, BUPA, REA Group, Tabcorp, Xero).</li> <li>Demonstrated success co-selling with major GSIs, regional consultancies, and cloud ecosystem vendors in ANZ.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in business, technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

description: Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick. About us Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on. Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself . We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves . From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM. Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading. What You Will Do: Proactively engage with and reache out to customer technical decision-makers and influencers. Utilizy information on customer business, industry, needs, competitive landscape, and key priorities to support the customer's digital transformation. Run data workshops to build plans for implementing solutions that align with customer business goals and technical environments. Drive pilots, proofs of concept (POC), and value (e.g., optimizing solutions and costs) and moves the customer forward from pilots to productive deployments by rooting pilots in business impact. Troubleshoot technical issues reported by customers during the implementation and ongoing campaign deployment process and provide solutions. Identify, escalate, and work to resolve technical blockers (e.g., changing configurations, sample coding) to accelerate architecture implementations, and route non-technical issues for removal by appropriate parties. Proactively engage with product and support teams (e.g., engineering) to remediate blockers by conveying impact. Leverage best practices to guide customer strategy and future growth for Insider One by cultivating customer affinity with Insider One solutions that drive impact for the customer. What You Will Need: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in consultative/complex technical deployment projects, architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of highly distributed applications. Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts. Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to orchestrate, lead, and influence virtual teams, ensuring the successful implementation of customer projects. Extensive technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, and technology management. Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies in one or more of the following: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS; REST, XML, database technologies. You have strong product command and technical domain knowledge of one or more of the following: SaaS, Marketing, Mobile Applications, APIs, or Programming. Strong communication skills in English and French. What We Offer: A chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment, “Tech Talks” with famous and groundbreaking people from the software world, To be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences. Don't believe us? Just ask Google. Access and opportunity to gain a limitless network all over the globe Access to many hard and soft skills pieces of training to help you improve and challenge yourself. Access to 16,000+ online courses taught by real-world professionals on the LinkedIn Learning platform to satisfy your hunger for knowledge. Space to share your skills through training sessions and workshops if you wish. Sharing is caring! Inclusive Private Health Insurance, Smart Work Model side benefits to support food and bill expenses, FUn with the occasional team activities! No Dress Code! We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status. title: Account Solutions Architect - Engaged - France
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>The infrastructure powering the AI era doesn’t sell itself, and the customers building on it don’t want to be sold to. They want a peer. You’ll work as part of a focused three-person team alongside one Account Executive and one Account Manager, together responsible for landing new accounts and expanding within them across the region. The customers you’ll work with are AI labs, research institutions, and enterprises running some of the most demanding GPU workloads in the world. This is a role for someone who shows up with substance, who can hold a real conversation about model training and MLOps tooling in the morning and cluster networking in the afternoon, and who finds the space between infrastructure and application more interesting than either on its own.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role:</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Solution Architect covering Northern EMEA, you’ll move across the full stack depending on what the customer needs, from ML training workflows and MLOps platforms like Weights & Biases to bare metal GPU infrastructure and physical AI deployments. This isn’t a role built around a single layer of the stack, but the majority of your conversations will live in the ML layer. You’ll be expected to go deeper than most when the infrastructure conversation demands it, while staying commercially aware enough to support both new logo pursuits and in-flight account expansion. This role requires up to 40% travel.</p> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Cover Northern EMEA, with a focus on the Nordics and Benelux regions (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Netherlands, Belgium, and Luxembourg).</li> <li>Work closely with one Account Executive and one Account Manager as a dedicated three-person unit, supporting the full land and expand motion across the region.</li> <li>Lead technical discovery with prospects and existing customers to understand model training requirements, MLOps workflows, and infrastructure constraints.</li> <li>Design and present solutions spanning ML infrastructure, GPU compute, storage, networking, Kubernetes-based orchestration, and MLOps tooling.</li> <li>Run proof-of-concept engagements and architecture reviews, and see them through to a decision.</li> <li>Act as the internal voice of the customer, feeding technical requirements and product gaps back to Engineering and Product.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of customer architectures, solution designs, and outstanding technical questions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture role, ideally with a focus on AI/ML platforms, cloud infrastructure, or HPC.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of ML training and inference workflows - you understand how models are built, optimized, and deployed, not just where they run.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with MLOps platforms and the tooling AI teams use day-to-day, including experiment tracking, pipeline orchestration, and model serving.</li> <li>Experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.</li> <li>Comfortable going below the SaaS layer when the conversation demands it - GPU topology, network fabric, and cluster architecture shouldn’t be unfamiliar territory.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads at scale.</li> <li>Strong communication skills - you can adjust your register from a research engineer to a VP of Infrastructure without losing credibility at either end.</li> <li>Experience managing multiple concurrent opportunities across a geographic territory.</li> <li>Fluency in English required; proficiency in Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100, A100, H200) and the software stack around them: CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN.</li> <li>Working knowledge of high-performance networking concepts: InfiniBand, RDMA, RoCE, TCP/IP.</li> <li>Background working directly with AI labs, research institutions, or enterprise ML teams.</li> <li>Exposure to physical AI use cases and the infrastructure requirements they bring.</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.</li> </ul> <p>Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams - even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.</p> <ul> <li>You’re comfortable going one layer deeper than the demo - whether that’s a networking topology, a training job that won’t converge, or a rack layout question from a facilities team.</li> <li>You’ve worked across more than one layer of the stack and find the intersections more interesting than any single discipline.</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving environment and take ownership of your region like it’s your own business.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who makes the people around you - including your AE and AM - better at their jobs.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h2> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p><em>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
description: TopChrono , leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies. Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous ! Ce que nous vous offrons Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs). Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière. Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement. Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation. Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact ! Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : Rattachement hiérarchique • Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au niveau national. Mission principale Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport. PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES Métrologie et maîtrise de la température • Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise. • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.). • Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements. • Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives. • Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC. Étude et déploiement des matériels • Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise. • Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée. • Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués. • Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels. • Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test. • Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température. • Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils. Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation • Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules. • Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité. • Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température. • Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels). • Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées. • Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées. Gestion des fournisseurs • Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques. • Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations. • Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires. • Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée. Qualité et amélioration continue • Participer aux audits internes et externes. • Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail. • Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance. • Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité. • Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue. • Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température). ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à : • proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ; • valider les choix techniques des installations ; • décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ; • arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ; • sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation. • Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations. RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES En interne • Direction des Opérations • Responsable Parc Automobile • Responsable Exploitation • Service Qualité • Conducteurs • Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température). En externe • Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques • Prestataires de métrologie • Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques. PROFIL RECHERCHE Formation • Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent. Expérience • 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire. • Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne. Compétences techniques • Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision. • Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid. • Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15- 140 / COFRAC). • Analyse de données de température. • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique. Qualités personnelles • Sens de l'organisation. • Rigueur et méthode. • Esprit d'analyse. • Capacité de prise de décision. • Aisance relationnelle. • Force de proposition. • Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs. • Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence. Objectifs du poste • Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques. • Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules. • Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique. • Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température. • Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport. • Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

vendor reviews.</li> <li>Support the commercial transactions legal team in negotiating data processing addendums and similar contractual language under global privacy laws.</li> <li>Support the corporate legal team on data and privacy-related due diligence for M&A transactions as well as supporting post-acquisition integration tasks related to privacy and AI compliance.</li> <li>Advise on data protection implications of and legal requirements applicable to security and privacy incidents, exercising judgment and discretion while advising cross-functional teams on incident handling procedures and communications. </li> <li>Create and contribute to playbooks and FAQ libraries for various teams to ensure they have the most current guidance related to privacy, data governance, and responsible AI.  </li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);"><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></span></p> <hr> <ul> <li>LLB/JD equivalent degree with strong The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> title: Developer GTM Strategy Manager, Technical Programs
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare is looking for a Strategy Manager to join the Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation team, focused on Technical Programs. This person will help Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, and Developer GTM leadership identify the right customer opportunities, organize technical GTM work, and turn high-value customer engagement into repeatable programs and operating rhythms.</p> <p>The Developer GTM Strategy & Incubation function exists to evolve the way the Developer GTM team works, designing systems, processes, and GTM motions that accelerate consumption at Cloudflare. This role is focused on the technical side of that motion: where we should spend time, how we coordinate technical resources, how we run customer-facing programs, and how we measure whether technical work is driving the right business outcomes.</p> <p>The right person is a high-agency operator with strong technical fluency. They do not need to be a Solutions Architect, but they should be comfortable working with technical products, customer architectures, implementation workflows, developer platforms, and customer-facing technical teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build and scale technical programs: </strong>Design proactive programs for Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and related technical GTM teams. Turn ad hoc motions into repeatable playbooks, operating rhythms, and ownership models where it makes sense.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate strategic customer engagement:</strong> Project manage high-priority customer initiatives that require technical GTM support. Clarify goals, stakeholders, timelines, resourcing, risks, success criteria, and follow-up.</li> <li><strong>Plan and scale technical onsite visits:</strong> Build the planning model for strategic customer onsites, including intake, agenda design, staffing, prep, execution, post-onsite follow-up, and measurement.</li> <li><strong>Improve prioritization and visibility:</strong> Own a clear view of active technical engagements, upcoming opportunities, blockers, outcomes, and resourcing needs. Partner with Revenue Engineering, Data, Sales Strategy, and technical leaders on account propensity, engagement tracking, dashboards, and operating reviews.</li> <li><strong>Support Professional Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and feedback loops for technical services offerings.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and launch new technical programs:</strong> Lead high-priority projects across Developer GTM, support team planning and process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of projects this person may own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a proactive SA/FDE engagement program for a priority customer segment or product motion.</li> <li>Partner on an account propensity model that helps determine SA/FDE prioritization, resourcing, and account coverage.</li> <li>Stand up a technical engagement tracker for active customer work, resourcing, blockers, and outcomes.</li> <li>Design the planning and follow-up model for technical onsite visits with strategic customers.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to package a repeatable services motion and build the business case for rollout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solutions Architects and FDEs have a clearer operating model for proactive programs and strategic customer engagements.</li> <li>Leadership has a reliable view of technical revenue pipeline, engagement health, account propensity, and investment ROI.</li> <li>Strategic customer initiatives and technical onsite visits move faster because goals, staffing, owners, success criteria, and follow-up are clear.</li> <li>Professional Services offerings are easier to understand, price, package, and align to Cloudflare's broader consumption-led strategy.</li> <li>New technical GTM motions move from ambiguous ideas to measurable programs with durable owners.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, technical program management, solutions strategy, consulting, or a similar cross-functional execution role.</li> <li>Experience working with technical customer-facing teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Developer Relations, or Product.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency, including the ability to understand customer architecture discussions, implementation tradeoffs, developer platform concepts, and the operating needs of technical GTM teams.</li> <li>Strong program management ability, including managing complex work streams, driving accountability without direct authority, and keeping teams aligned under pressure.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership; someone who takes initiative, works independently, and manages time effectively.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Highly customer-centric, with natural curiosity about technical products and a strategic mindset for solving complex problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working under pressure and adjusting priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including comfort using spreadsheets, CRM data, and business dashboards to prioritize work and inform decisions.</li> <li>Prior experience with Salesforce CRM, Tableau, BigQuery, or BoostUp is a plus.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) is a strong plus.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $161,000 - $221,000</li> <li>For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $153,000 - $210,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> &

Engage with genuine fluency on infrastructure, APIs, developer experience, cloud architecture, and security — translating Cloudflare's capabilities into outcomes that matter to people who build things.</li> <li><strong>Product-Led Growth Conversion: </strong>Identify accounts where individual or team-level usage of Cloudflare's platform signals a commercial opportunity. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.</li> <li>Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. Contribute to Cloudflare's understanding of how this segment builds, buys, and scales — and help the organisation stay relevant and competitive in a fast-moving market.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience in B2B technology sales, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding new logo and quota targets, ideally selling to digital-native, developer-led, startup, or scale-up companies.</li> <li>Proven hunter mentality in a digital-native or startup context — you know how to find the right companies, get in front of the right people, and close before the window closes. Ensure all construction activities and global workflows are in strict compliance with local laws while maintaining a focus on sustainable, high-performance building standards.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Proven Seniority:</strong> 10-12+ years of experience leading interior design and complex construction project management, specifically within high-growth technology companies or global enterprises.</li> <li><strong>Scale Mastery:</strong> A proven track record of successfully directing a global corporate office portfolio in excess of 250,000+ total square feet.</li> <li><strong>Curiosity & Growth Mindset:</strong> A profound curiosity for how technology can optimize human interaction. You must be comfortable with ambiguity and excited by the challenge of building unprecedented internal tools from scratch rather than managing legacy workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Integration:</strong> Knowledge of technical infrastructure (MEP systems, architectural principles, AV/IT) and a clear vision of how they connect with automated building systems.</li> <li><strong>Sophisticated Communication:</strong> Outstanding leadership and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional executives and external partners across multiple time zones.</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field such as Architecture, Project Management, Interior Design, or Engineering.</li> <li><strong>Global Mobility & Presence:</strong> Willingness to work in-office ~3 days a week to lead by example within our local workplace laboratory, with the flexibility to travel globally to oversee high-stakes project transformations.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Certifications:</strong> LEED, WELL, or PMP Certifications.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Technical Skills:</strong> Experience with AI-enhanced workflows, generative design platforms, or transitioning legacy portfolios into AI-assisted operational models.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $223,000 - We’re looking for a seasoned product leader who will take charge of these processes, providing leadership, communication and accountability for successful delivery. You will: </p> <ul> <li>Take leadership. You will manage a small team of product managers ensuring coverage and accountability for the myriad projects across the organization. </li> <li>Work horizontally. Disparate groups like Engineering, Program Management, Finance, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence and external vendors like Stripe and Salesforce all need to keep plans aligned and work together to deliver commitments.</li> <li>Span timescales. Short term deliverables like supporting product launches, medium term ones like migrating billing progresses and longer term ones like a full ERP implementation all need to be serviced. The urgent cannot starve the important. </li> <li>Span domains. You need to simultaneously let other teams rely on the roadmaps you publish while being responsive to the interrupt-driven nature of the business. When shifts do occur, you need to proactively communicate with other teams to maintain trust. </li> <li>Commit to quality. Our #1 priority is to have an accurate picture of revenue and service of our customers but we also have numerous other concerns like speed of innovation and advancing the roadmap.</li> <li>Communicate and collaborate. Essential to the success of this program is the ability to listen, learn, synthesize and communicate outwards as well as influence through persuasion.</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare. Many of our largest customers want to speak to us about their concerns and our plans in the billing domain. You will spend time learning from them. </li> <li>Provide and demand accountability. You are responsible for the delivery of your commitments and you will hold your peers and subordinates accountable for theirs. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Some of the domains you will touch include</strong>: Billing, Invoicing, Sales & Opportunity management, Credit & Collections, Pricing & Quoting, Contract & Entitlement Management, Partners & Resellers, Taxation, Bad debt, BI Reporting, ERP Implementation. </p> <p><strong>Success Factors</strong></p> <p>100% essential to taking on this role will be a history of success delivering projects within the financial domain. A history of product management in billing, fintech, financial reporting, compliance or other similar domain in companies with scope similar to or larger than Cloudflare is required. We will also only consider candidates who have successfully managed teams of other product managers in one of these domains. </p> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Internet native companies tend to think a little differently than the Fortune 500. We’d love to meet folks with a history of delivering with the cadence and timescales of those born on the Internet. </li> <li>Engineering fluency - while it’s not required, we tend to find success with candidates who have a technical background, formal or otherwise. You don’t need a CS degree but building credibility with our engineering teams is critical and so some history of technical acumen would be super helpful</li> <li>Finance fluency - You’re dealing with data that represents money and that implies a certain level of care. title: Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in. This role reports to the VP of Strategic Finance, Treasury, Deal Desk, & Investor Relations and is the engine room of how Cloudflare tells its financial story to the public markets — translating one of the most differentiated technology platforms in the world into a clear, credible, and compelling investment narrative.</p> <p>You will own the end-to-end quarterly earnings cycle, drive our long-term financial model and consensus discipline, partner directly with the CFO and senior leadership on guidance, and lead the analytical and communications work behind every major investor and analyst touchpoint — quarterly calls, conferences, our annual Investor Day, and ad-hoc executive projects. We move fast, we ship work that goes directly to the CEO, CFO, Board, and public markets, and we hold ourselves to an exceptionally high bar on accuracy — and we are AI-native in how we work, treating modern tooling as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, and rigor.</p> <h4><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h4> <p>As the Director, Strategic Finance & Investor Relations, you will be the operational and analytical lead for Cloudflare's engagement with the public markets.
