title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Freelance
description: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées À propos de l'opportunité Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants. En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route. Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp. Vos missions Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes. Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp. Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels. Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat. Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp. Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits. Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain. Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes. Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux. Ce que nous recherchons Indispensable Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons. Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects. Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs. Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu. La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections. Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux. La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer. Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients. La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients. Atouts Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp. Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente. Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain. Rémunération Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés. Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner : Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions. Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème. Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème. Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans. Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois. Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales. Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer. Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables. Formation et accompagnement Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients. Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage. Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation. Job Application Tip We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&index=8&md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=and&index=9&md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=AstraZeneca&index=10&md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=11&md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  </p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> <strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1917 </p> <p><strong>The Role: <br></strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p></p> <p>You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.</p> <ul> <li>Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification</li> <li>Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort</li> </ul> <p></p> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p></p> <p>We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.</p> <p>Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.</p> <ul> <li>Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills</li> <li>Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></p> <p>You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. </p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE : L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. Ta mission : construire avec l'IA les outils qui vont démultiplier la productivité de toute l'entreprise ! CE QUE TU FERAS : Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien. Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue. Specs & architecture : Traduire les besoins en specs concises et en décisions d'architecture documentées, pour que chaque choix soit tracé et facilement repris par l'équipe Tech. Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette ! L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier. Mesure & itération : Définir des critères de succès avec le métier, mesurer l'adoption et l'impact de tes outils, et itérer rapidement à partir des données et des retours utilisateurs. Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau. TU ES AU BON ENDROIT SI : Tu maîtrises le développement full-stack en TypeScript (React, Node.js) sur AWS et GitHub, et tu livres du code de qualité production. Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN. Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles. Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code. Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien. Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite. Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique. ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager. CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE : 💵 Rémunération : Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons. 🏖 Congés payés : 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés. 🍜 Ticket restaurant : Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour). 🚇 Transport en commun : 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna. 🚑 Assurance santé : Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna 🏄 Événements d'équipe : Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble. 🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) ! NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT : En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! Voici plus de détail ci-dessous : Un 1er échange avec Gianni (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 45' → Tu pourras mieux comprendre le rôle, les missions et ce qu'on attend pour ce poste. Un Hiring Manager Interview avec Guillaume (CPTO) - 45' → Cela te permettra d'entrer dans le détail du poste : les missions au quotidien, les défis et les attentes liées au rôle. Un Skills-based Assessment avec Kseniia (Engineering Manager) et Maxime (Senior Staff Engineer) - 60' → Le case te donne l'occasion de montrer concrètement tes compétences et ton savoir-faire en lien avec le job. Un Seynalma Interview avec Charlotte (Client Performance Director) et Anne-Céline (Senior CSM) - 2x45' → Cela te permettra de voir si notre culture d'entreprise colle avec tes valeurs et ta façon de travailler. Un Final Interview avec Stephen (CEO) - 30' → C'est le moment d'échanger avec notre CEO et de voir si tes drivers matchent avec nos 3 Unique Selling Propositions pour les Talents ! title: Sales Development Representative - CDI
description: Qui sommes-nous ? Notre mission Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation. ⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation . Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement” 👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 ! 💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux ! Le mot de la CEO “Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs. Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon Et ce poste alors ? Le rôle En première ligne de notre développement commercial , tu travailleras main dans la main avec le Sales Manager et les Account Executives au sein d'une équipe outillée et ambitieuse, sur un cycle de vente court. Missions et responsabilités Prospection intensive et ciblée (Outbound) : Identifier et qualifier des comptes clés dans le secteur de l'installation solaire. Tu contacteras les prospects via une approche multicanale avec une majorité de Cold Calling (notre cible d'artisans est très réceptive au téléphone), du Cold Emailing et LinkedIn. Qualification des leads (Inbound & Outbound) : Traiter rapidement les demandes entrantes générées par le marketing. Tu devras qualifier les besoins lors des premiers appels de découverte et transformer l'intérêt en rendez-vous de démonstration qualifié pour l'équipe de closing. Rigueur opérationnelle et Data : Assurer une tenue irréprochable de notre CRM (HubSpot) via la mise à jour des statuts, la prise de notes et le log des appels. Tu utiliseras notre stack et suivras tes KPIs quotidiens et hebdomadaires. Amélioration continue : Remonter les objections fréquentes et les retours du terrain au VP Sales et au Marketing pour affiner le discours. Tu participeras activement aux sessions de coaching et de partage de bonnes pratiques de l'équipe. Tes objectifs: ⭐ 0 à 1 mois : L'onboarding et les premiers pas Acquérir une compréhension parfaite du produit Solteo, de la proposition de valeur et du marché cible. Prendre en main la stack technique (HubSpot, Aircall, Apollo) et lancer tes premières séquences de prospection et appels à froid pour générer tes premiers SQL. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtrise du pitch commercial, des outils de prospection et autonomie dans la génération de rendez-vous. ⭐ 1 à 8 mois : L'exécution et la machine à leads Exécuter les séquences avec régularité et intensité. Atteindre et dépasser tes quotas de rendez-vous bookés. Devenir une machine de qualification tout en encaissant les refus sans perdre ta motivation. 🎯 Objectif : Alimenter continuellement les agendas des Account Executives avec des leads ultra-qualifiés. ⭐ À partir de 8 mois : Les premières démos (Closing) C'est la concrétisation de ta montée en compétences ! Tu ne fais plus que prospecter : tu commences à prendre le relais sur la suite du cycle de vente en réalisant tes premières démonstrations produit auprès des prospects que tu as qualifiés. 🎯 Objectif : Maîtriser l'exercice de la démo et initier ta transition vers le closing. ⭐ >1 an : L'évolution Participer à l'amélioration des process de prospection et transmettre ton savoir aux nouveaux arrivants. 🎯 Objectif : Évoluer officiellement vers un poste d'Account Executive (Closer) à temps plein ou prendre des responsabilités managériales au sein de l'équipe SDR. Les compétences qu’on recherche Formation : Tu as une expérience dans la vente SaaS B2B ! Mindset : Tu as un mindset d'entrepreneur, tu aimes relever des challenges et mettre la main à la pâte. Humilité et capacité à se remettre en question : Forte envie de progresser et de prendre des responsabilités. Langues : Français et Anglais parfaitement bilingues/fluents. Ce qui serait un plus Une expérience dans la Construction Tech ou l' Energy Tech , ou auprès des artisans et du bâtiment. Une réelle motivation pour les projets à impact et la transition énergétique. Mais Solteo c’est aussi… Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée. La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens. Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer ! Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante . Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe ! Processus de recrutement 📞 Entretien de cadrage avec une recruteuse (30 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste. 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec Manon (CEO). 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case . 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call). 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo. title: Head of Integrated Marketing France
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>À propos du poste</h2> <p>Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Integrated Marketing France pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing France, basée à Paris.</p> <p>Rattaché(e) à la Head of Marketing France, vous piloterez l'une des trois équipes Marketing du marché français et managerez une équipe de 3 personnes.</p> <p>Votre mission : être le point de connexion entre la stratégie Global et son exécution sur le marché France, en fédérant l'ensemble des parties prenantes autour d'une vision marketing claire, cadrée et exécutée dans les temps.</p> <p>À la croisée de la stratégie, de l'orchestration et de l'exécution, vous porterez la vision marketing France auprès du Global et des instances exécutives locales, tout en veillant à ce que chaque campagne — globale ou locale — soit livrée avec excellence et dans les délais. Vous piloterez également le programme de fidélité en France.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <ul> <li>Définir et porter la vision stratégique marketing France, en s'appuyant sur une compréhension fine de la stratégie Global et en assurant sa traduction pertinente sur le marché français (spécificités locales : créa, moments de consommation, culture...).</li> <li>Être l'interlocuteur constructif du Global : savoir s'intégrer dans une stratégie globale tout en la challengeant de façon argumentée lorsque les spécificités françaises le nécessitent.</li> <li>Fédérer l'ensemble des pôles (Sales, Brand & Media, Creative, CRM, Analytics, Global...) pour s'assurer que chacun travaille vers les mêmes objectifs et dans le même calendrier.</li> <li>Piloter et sécuriser le calendrier de livraison des campagnes (globales et locales) : brief à temps, validation des plans média, validation brand, etc., pour garantir une exécution sans accroc.</li> <li>Simplifier et cadrer des sujets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes, en faisant émerger les décisions à prendre et en portant les recommandations qui en découlent.</li> <li>Formaliser et présenter la vision et la performance marketing France à un niveau exécutif, avec clarté et impact.</li> <li>Piloter le programme de fidélité en France, en garantissant sa cohérence avec la stratégie marketing globale et les priorités business locales.</li> <li>Intégrer l'IA dans les méthodes de travail de l'équipe, pour gagner en efficacité et en qualité d'exécution.</li> <li>Manager et développer une équipe de 3 personnes, en apportant vision, coaching, structure et exigence d'exécution.</li> </ul> <h2>Le profil recherché</h2> <p>Vous êtes un(e) leader marketing structuré(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à simplifier des sujets complexes multi-stakeholders et à faire en sorte que les choses avancent.</p> <p>Vous apportez notamment :</p> <ul> <li>8 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing, avec une expérience significative dans des environnements matriciels et multi-marchés.</li> <li>Une capacité avérée à travailler à l'interface du Global et du Local, en sachant à la fois s'aligner sur une stratégie globale et la challenger de façon constructive quand nécessaire.</li> <li>Un leadership naturel pour fédérer, cadrer et orchestrer des sujets impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes, sans lien hiérarchique direct sur la plupart d'entre elles.</li> <li>Une forte capacité de formalisation et de communication, notamment pour porter une vision ou une recommandation devant un public exécutif.</li> <li>Une orientation PMO marquée : rigueur, sens du détail, capacité à garder le contrôle sur des plannings complexes et à faire respecter les délais.</li> <li>Une appétence pour l'IA et son intégration dans les méthodes de travail marketing.</li> <li>Une expérience réussie en management et dans le développement de talents.</li> <li>Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.</li> </ul> <h2>Les compétences qui feront votre réussite</h2> <ul> <li>Leadership et fédération d'équipes transverses</li> <li>Simplification et cadrage de sujets complexes</li> <li>Sens de l'organisation et rigueur (PMO)</li> <li>Capacité à challenger de façon constructive</li> <li>Communication et formalisation à niveau exécutif</li> <li>Gestion de projet et respect des délais</li> <li>Appétence pour l'IA et les nouveaux outils</li> <li>Management et développement de talents</li> <li>Connaissance du média (brand et performance)</li> <li>Orientation business, à l'aise avec la data et le reporting chiffré</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around title: Backend Java Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Airship</strong></p> <p>Airship is trusted by world’s leading brands such as Alaska Airlines, BBC and The Home Depot to drive revenue growth and customer loyalty with exceptional cross-channel customer experiences. Today, brands are challenged to deliver seamless, unified customer experiences across a fragmented array of channels and devices— apps, websites, email, SMS, wallets and more. </p> <p>Airship’s no-code, AI-powered platform was designed with non-technical, growth-focused teams in mind, making it easy to create, test and orchestrate hyper-personalized experiences across all channels. With the ability to easily enrich customer data and rapidly launch growth experiments, Airship enables brands to deliver consistent, meaningful interactions that accelerate conversion and foster deeper customer relationships.</p> <p>We invite you to be part of our journey in building products and delivering services that touch millions of customers around the world every day.</p> <p>To learn more about us, visit <a href="https://www.airship.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw3xEidfNT5kaSMR1LbqH2tz">www.airship.com</a>, read our <a href="https://www.airship.com/blog/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.airship.com/blog/&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2S7rp6uesS3WbpmG9CFOaR">blog</a> or follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/airship-social&source=gmail&ust=1727358600004000&usg=AOvVaw2T3DnwhcK_pt63jzkrYdK6">LinkedIn.</a></p></div><h4>About the Role</h4> <p>As a Backend Java Engineer, you will design, develop, and support distributed systems that combine scale with high reliability. You will work on low-latency services that process continuous event streams and support analytical workloads across terabytes of data. Our backend infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform. It uses Java-based microservices and SQL and NoSQL databases. You will join a core engineering team that shapes Airship’s technical foundations and engineering practices.</p> <h4>What You'll Do</h4> <ul> <li>Design data schemas and take ownership of data semantics</li> <li>Maintain, improve, and scale Java APIs and distributed services</li> <li>Investigate performance issues using server metrics, application data, and system behavior</li> <li>Improve the reliability, testability, and maintainability of our backend systems</li> <li>Partner with product and engineering teams on technical design and implementation</li> <li>Help define technical standards across teams</li> <li>Lead and own large-scale releases and technical projects</li> <li>Use AI as a technical assistant to draft development plans and investigate problems or bugs</li> <li>Critically assess AI-generated suggestions for accuracy, security, and suitability</li> </ul> <p>Duties and responsibilities described are not comprehensive. Additional tasks may be assigned, or the role’s scope may change based on business needs.</p> <h4>What We're Looking For</h4> <ul> <li>At least three years of experience designing, operating, and maintaining distributed systems</li> <li>Professional fluency in spoken and written French</li> <li>Strong Java development skills</li> <li>Experience with unit testing, code reviews, documentation, and Git-based version control</li> <li>Experience leading significant releases or technical projects</li> <li>Familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>A collaborative and pragmatic approach to software development</li> <li>A commitment to building reliable, maintainable, and testable systems</li> </ul> <h4>We'd Be Delighted If You Also Have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience troubleshooting and improving JVM performance</li> <li>Experience with Google Cloud Platform</li> <li>Knowledge of distributed NoSQL databases or key-value stores</li> <li>Strong Linux administration fundamentals</li> </ul> <h4>Work Location & Travel Requirements</h4> <p>Airship’s ‘Digital First’ approach to work means that for the majority of our roles, work can be performed remotely, either some or most of the time. Airship believes that flexible work contributes to a more productive and more equitable work environment, and that Airshippers are able to collaborate, innovate, and support one another across different locations and timezones.</p> <p>Some roles may require that employees perform their work from a specific location to support business activities, and/or be within proximity to an Airship office location or customer or partner locations, while other roles can be performed 100% remotely. </p> <p>This position is <strong>fully remote</strong> and may require <strong>up to 10%</strong> travel based on business needs or as requested by your manager.</p> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Starting pay may vary based on factors such as relevant skills, work experience, market demands, and location. All offers include stock options so employees have the opportunity to benefit from Airship’s success. </p> <p><strong>Benefits & Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical insurance options for you and your dependents</li> <li>Flexible time off, paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid volunteer time off </li> <li>Support for your overall wellbeing with employer-subsidized mental health and employee wellness programs</li> <li>A digital-first work environment and a monthly stipend to support remote work</li> <li>Mentorship and growth opportunities to build skills and accelerate professional development</li> <li>And more!</li> </ul> <h4>AI in Recruiting</h4> <p>We use artificial intelligence tools in our recruitment process as decision-support tools only. Airship's People Operations team reviews all AI-generated scores and recommendations before making any hiring determination. No applicant is rejected solely on the basis of an AI-generated output. Depending on your location, you may have the right to request human review of any AI-assisted employment decision or to opt out of AI evaluation. title: DevOps Engineer
description: Join our mission We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run. After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective. Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster. About the role Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers. As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world. Our culture We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers. Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely. What we're looking for Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale. title: AI Support Engineer Lead
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . Summary At Dust, we're building for a new kind of AI Operator : people who rethink and rebuild how their teams work around AI. Not “how can AI help us do this faster?” but “if AI existed from day one, would we even do this the same way?” As our AI Support Engineering Lead , you'll own how Support is built and scaled at Dust. This is a deeply hands-on role. You'll take on the hardest customer issues when our agents fall short, but your job isn't simply to resolve them. You'll look for the pattern behind each issue and turn what you learn into better agents, automation, tooling, documentation, and product improvements. Over time, you'll help grow the team and shape how Support Engineering operates as Dust scales. You'll define, ship, and continuously iterate on the systems that make this possible: AI agents, automation workflows, classification systems, knowledge systems, and tooling built on top of Dust itself. You'll dogfood the product harder than almost anyone at the company and set the standard for how the rest of the Support Engineering team does the same. We're looking for someone who wants to lead from the work: technically strong, obsessed with building better systems, and excited to shape both the team and the function as we grow. What you'll do Build the AI systems that do the work Set the technical direction for the support stack: what gets automated, in what order, and to what standard. You make the calls, not just the builds. Design, ship, and maintain AI agents and automation workflows that reduce manual support load: think ticket classification, acknowledgment automation, response drafting, incident detection, and proactive user outreach. Identify recurring categories of issues and engineer them out of existence through automation, documentation, prompt iteration, or product feedback. Build and maintain tooling (MCP integrations, Dust agents, internal scripts) that increase the team's capacity without increasing headcount. Define and own the "Support as a Product" backlog. You decide what goes on it, coach the team to execute it, and hold the bar on what shipped means. Run support when the systems fall short Hire, onboard, and develop the support engineers around you. You're not just resolving tickets and building systems, you're growing the people who will. Set the standard for how complex issues get handled at Dust. You take the hardest tickets yourself. The team knows what good looks like because they've watched you do it. Investigate complex issues across logs, code, and internal tooling to identify root causes and provide clear answers to customers. Handle escalated cases with precise, accessible communication for both technical and non-technical audiences. Systematically analyze agent-generated responses for inconsistencies and iterate on prompts, documentation, and tooling until human intervention is minimal. Bridge customer pain to product improvements Represent support at the engineering and product level. You synthesize signal, prioritize it, and push it through with enough context that it actually moves things, not just relays it. Build strong working relationships with engineers and customer-facing teams to ensure efficient, high-context escalations. Own the feedback loop end-to-end: when agents fail due to missing or incorrect information, close the gap across engineering, product, and documentation. Requirements Every candidate and employee's success is measured against the same 3 dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude and Agency. Aptitude Function-building experience: You've defined or significantly shaped a support engineering function before: built the operating model, set the standards, hired into the team, or rebuilt a broken process from scratch. High technical aptitude: comfortable reading code, analyzing logs, navigating codebases, and troubleshooting distributed systems. You're not stopped by a stack trace. AI fluency at builder level: track record of building custom agents, automations, or workflows using AI tools (Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, etc.); not just prompting. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, what to escalate, and, critically, what to delegate and to whom. You make these calls for yourself and for the team, fast and without second-guessing. People leadership: You've coached and developed engineers and know how to set expectations, give direct feedback, and raise the performance of the people around you. Bidirectional communication: can translate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and speak technical language fluently with engineers. Build/Run mindset: You believe the best Support Engineering teams don't just resolve issues. They build systems that prevent those issues from recurring. Attitude Builder mentality: You instinctively automate repetitive work rather than accepting inefficient systems, and you hold your team to the same standard. Resilience-empathy paradox: You can absorb customer frustration without taking it personally while still deeply caring about the user experience. Leads by example: You're not above the queue. When something is hard, you take it. Exceptional prioritization: You know what to solve immediately, what to automate, and what to escalate. Thrives in ambiguity: You enjoy building systems from scratch in environments where many processes are still undefined. Low ego, team player: You share knowledge freely and care about the success of the broader team. Agency High ownership: You define what needs to be done as often as you execute it. You don't wait for someone to tell you the function has a gap. Systems-first thinking: You focus on eliminating categories of work, not simply resolving tickets faster. You hold yourself and the team accountable to that distinction. Pattern recognition to repeatability: You turn recurring issues into scalable systems, automations, workflows, or documentation that eliminate future occurrences. Deep investigation instincts: You investigate as far as possible before escalating, providing engineering teams with thoughtful, high-context information when collaboration is needed, and you coach the team to do the same. Even if you don’t meet every requirement above, we still encourage you to apply. We care deeply about curiosity, potential, and determination, and we know exceptional people don’t always fit neatly into a checklist. Benefits & Compensation Competitive compensation based on level and experience 100,000€ - 160,000€ Significant equity package at a Sequoia-backed startup Health benefits for you and your dependents New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, etc. Opportunity to travel between our Paris and San Francisco offices Regular team events and off-sites Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. title: Head of ClinOps Data Management RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . Ce que tu feras chez nous Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation . Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à : Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne. Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume. Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle. À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours : Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire. Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients. title: Embedded Engineer
description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy. What You Will Do Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots. Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample. Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities. Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast. Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline. Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data. Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong. Requirements Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems. Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar). Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar. Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar. A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly. Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger. Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice. High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be". Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care. Fluent in English. German is a plus. Nice to Have A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices. Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops. Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design. Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script. Open-source firmware contributions. Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support. Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits: Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it. Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it. Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them. Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes. This is for you if: You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec. You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one. You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do. This is not for you if: You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5. You would forward output you cannot explain. "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer. How We Hire We read every application and reply within five working days. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem. Then a decision, usually within a few days. Pay Transparency Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting. What We Offer Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter. Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval. A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage. Free food and drinks in the office. Equal Opportunity MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity. Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.</p> <p>Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.</li> <li>Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.</li> <li>Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.</li> <li>Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.</li> <li>Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.</li> <li>Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.</li> <li>Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.</li> <li>Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.</li> </ul> <h2>Ce que nous recherchons</h2> <h3>Indispensable</h3> <ul> <li>Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.</li> <li>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises title: Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive based in France. As an Account Executive, you will drive business growth across Europe by selling cutting-edge cloud infrastructure technology to enterprise customers, cloud providers, and fast-growing AI and developer platforms. You will own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to technical evaluations, pilot programs, commercial negotiations, and closing deals. Working closely with the founding team and technical experts, you will help customers understand how next-generation microvirtualization can improve workload isolation, security, and infrastructure efficiency. You will build a qualified pipeline through strategic outbound campaigns, industry networking, and targeted account development. As an early sales hire, you will have a direct influence on the go-to-market strategy, sales processes, and future growth of the commercial organization. This fully remote opportunity combines entrepreneurial ownership, technical learning, and uncapped earning potential in a rapidly evolving AI and cloud infrastructure market. Accountabilities Build, manage, and grow a European sales pipeline targeting enterprise infrastructure teams, cloud and hosting providers, and high-growth AI and developer technology companies. Own the full sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying prospects to conducting discovery calls, coordinating technical evaluations, negotiating commercial terms, and securing signed contracts. Develop and execute targeted outbound strategies in collaboration with go-to-market engineers, identifying priority accounts, key decision-makers, and effective messaging to generate qualified opportunities. Lead customer conversations and engage economic buyers early, building relationships with CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security teams, procurement professionals, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions. Coordinate product demonstrations, technical deep dives, and proof-of-concept or pilot programs alongside founders and field engineers to demonstrate product value and accelerate customer adoption. Translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes, showing customers how lightweight microvirtual machines can improve workload isolation, infrastructure utilization, security, and deployment speed. Apply structured qualification methodologies, including MEDDPICC, to assess deal quality, understand decision-making processes, identify risks, and convert successful pilots into long-term production commitments. Develop commercial proposals tailored to customer requirements, including usage-based pricing, minimum commitments, dedicated deployments, and bring-your-own-cloud arrangements. Identify opportunities for account expansion by working closely with field engineers and existing customers to understand evolving infrastructure needs and increase adoption. Represent the business at industry conferences, cloud-native events, AI infrastructure gatherings, and regional meetups, building relationships and converting networking opportunities into qualified pipeline. Collaborate with go-to-market engineers to develop creative prospecting campaigns, improve sales automation, and refine outreach strategies based on market feedback and campaign performance. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the sales playbook, sharing insights on customer needs, competitive positioning, objections, and emerging market trends with the founding team and product organization. Maintain accurate records in HubSpot, manage pipeline reporting, and provide reliable forecasts to support business planning and sales execution. Support opportunities across the United States when needed, coordinating with the wider team and accommodating regular calls during European evening hours. Help shape the future sales organization by establishing repeatable processes, sharing best practices, and contributing to the onboarding and development of future sales hires. Requirements: At least 4 years of experience in quota-carrying sales or closing roles, selling technical products to engineering-oriented buyers. Proven experience selling technical solutions, ideally within cloud infrastructure, DevOps, developer tooling, virtualization, serverless computing, or related technology markets. Demonstrated ability to build a sales pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account research, networking, and targeted engagement strategies. Strong understanding of effective outbound sales practices, with the ability to develop compelling messaging, prioritize accounts, and guide others in improving prospecting performance. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving technical evaluations, proof-of-concept programs, and extended decision-making processes. Ability to engage confidently with technical and economic buyers, including CTOs, platform engineering leaders, security stakeholders, procurement teams, and legal departments. Sufficient technical knowledge to discuss virtualization, containers, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and related technologies credibly with engineering teams, combined with the curiosity and motivation to deepen your expertise. Experience converting pilots, proofs of concept, or technical evaluations into signed commercial agreements. Familiarity with usage-based pricing, consumption-based business models, minimum commitments, or other flexible commercial structures. Strong prospecting, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to make customers feel comfortable while maintaining a rigorous, analytical approach to sales. Excellent spoken and written English, with additional languages considered an advantage. A high degree of ownership, initiative, adaptability, and learning agility, with the ability to identify problems, take action independently, and continuously improve how work gets done. Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to pipeline management, deal qualification, forecasting, and sales performance. Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations. Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line. Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies. Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints. Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows. Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits. Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams. What We Offer Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes. Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage. High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: Research Lead, Predictive Oncology

Publications, presentations and external collaborations will be integral outputs of that programme. You will work closely with the CTO and our Data Science, Computational Biology, experimental, product and engineering colleagues. What You'll Do Own O-Predict's long-term research roadmap: define and maintain a 2-year scientific agenda, translated into a prioritised 12-month execution plan. Identify the key uncertainties, research hypotheses, data requirements, dependencies and resources; set milestones and explicit criteria for continuing, redirecting or stopping projects. Review priorities with the CTO as evidence and company needs evolve. Lead R&D execution: take research programmes from question formulation through method development, validation and interpretation. Coordinate agreed contributions across Data Science, Computational Biology and experimental teams, establish project ownership, run scientific reviews, resolve blockers and mentor researchers. Shape future data generation: identify the experiments, measurements and cohorts that would resolve important scientific uncertainties. Co-design these studies with experimental and clinical colleagues, prioritise them within the agreed research allocation, and use the results to test and revise your hypotheses. Advance O-Predict's predictive capabilities: investigate how drug screening, patient-derived models, molecular and clinical data can improve treatment-response and trial-outcome predictions. Assess extensions to new cohorts, indications and therapeutic settings, specifying the evidence needed before extending claims. Own the validation strategy: define relevant endpoints, external baselines and evaluation protocols. Lead independent and prospective validation plans with clinical and experimental collaborators, and document both performance and failure modes. Connect research to product development: work with product and engineering colleagues to translate promising findings into reproducible methods and clearly documented scientific requirements. Minimum Qualifications PhD, PharmD, MD, or MSc with an equivalent research record in a quantitative or biomedical discipline relevant to predictive oncology. Experience leading and mentoring scientific contributors , including coordinating work across disciplines and critically reviewing others' methods and conclusions. A strong publication record in translational oncology, computational biology, biostatistics and/or ML for health , with clear intellectual and analytical contributions. Hands-on proficiency in Python and SQL: you can work with internal data and libraries, develop and evaluate methods, and produce reproducible analyses and figures. Strong grounding in statistical inference, predictive modelling and study design; able to challenge biological assumptions and machine-learning evaluations. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading R&D in a biotech, health technology or translational research setting, with responsibility for milestones and resource planning. Experience translating research methods into a predictive product or decision-support workflow. Familiarity with patient-derived models, drug sensitivity assays, clinical trial design and oncology endpoints. title: Embedded System Lead Engineer
description: Pelagon - Autonomous Maritime ISR Full-time · On-site (Marseille or Paris) · Founding team · Reports to founders The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer. Founded by Aymeric (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats. France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service. Pelagon is backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised. The role As Embedded System Lead Engineer , you take end-to-end technical ownership of the hardware, electronics, and embedded stack across a small family of autonomous maritime platforms, some operating on the surface, some beneath it. What they share matters more than what sets them apart: each must persist at sea for long stretches, sense its surroundings, run our AI on-device, and report back intelligently — all while surviving a brutal environment on a very tight energy budget. You will lead their technical development , from architecture and component selection through bring-up, integration, sea trials, and iteration. You'll set the engineering bar for the platforms team and shape how we build for years to come. These platforms exist to carry one thing into the water: our AI. Pelagon trains high-performance detection models in-house on its own stack, and those models have to run on-device, at the edge , on a razor-thin power budget — then push results back to our operations center. Designing the compute-and-power architecture that makes this possible is the heart of the role. The mandate is simple and uncompromising: get reliable hardware in the water fast, and start collecting data. Every week of persistent at-sea operation compounds. The hardware is the gate to all of it. What you'll own Common system architecture across the platforms: power, sensing, compute, and communications. The edge-AI compute platform — selecting and integrating the processors and accelerators that run our in-house detection models on-device, and extracting maximum inference from every milliwatt. Electronics design and integration — power distribution, battery systems, motor/thruster control, sensor interfaces (acoustic, pressure, IMU, GNSS, AIS). The embedded software and autopilot stack, firmware, and the low-level glue that makes autonomy reliable in a brutal, wet, salty environment. Robustness and efficiency engineering: watertight integrity, power budgets and endurance, thermal behaviour, EMC, and graceful failure modes far from shore. Hands-on bring-up and sea trials — you'll be on the dock and on the boat, not just at the bench. Vendor and component decisions, and the build-up of our test and manufacturing practices as we scale from prototype to fielded units. The hard problems you'll be solving These are genuinely difficult, and that's the point: Persistence with a finite power budget. Endurance is everything for a surveillance node — squeezing weeks of useful operation out of a sealed, ship-deployable platform is a relentless optimization problem across power, compute, and duty-cycling. Reliability with no one to fix it. A system at sea has to fail safe and recover on its own. There is no field technician at 30 nm offshore in a 2 m swell. Running real AI at the edge, on almost no power. This is the defining challenge of the role. Our in-house models have to run inference on-device, in real time, on platforms with a razor-thin energy budget — then sense, sleep, and wake intelligently to stretch endurance from hours into weeks. Getting high-performance ML to live within milliwatts is what makes the entire system possible. Sensing in a hostile medium. The ocean fights you at every turn — pressure, corrosion, biofouling, acoustic noise, intermittent comms — and the hardware has to keep sensing and computing through all of it. Speed without fragility. We are building fast toward sea trials, but a demonstrator that breaks doesn't generate data. You'll have to find the line between moving quickly and building things that survive the ocean. Who we're looking for You are a sharp, senior builder who wants to own a problem, not be handed a ticket. Specifically: 5+ years building real, shipping hardware — embedded systems that had to be efficient, robust, and survive the real world. Direct experience building drones or autonomous systems . This could come from drone companies (e.g. Parrot), automotive / autonomous vehicles, or the marine autonomy space. Deep, hands-on command of the full embedded stack : electronics design, power systems, motor/actuator control, sensor integration, microcontrollers and embedded Linux, and firmware close to the metal. Comfort with autopilot / flight-controller ecosystems (Pixhawk, ArduPilot / ArduSub / PX4 or equivalent) and the realities of real-time control. Experience deploying AI/ML models at the edge — embedded inference, accelerators (GPU / NPU / TPU-class), model quantization and optimization, and the power-versus-performance tradeoffs that come with it. This is central to what we do. A bias toward action: you prototype, test, break, and iterate — and you're energized by tight deadlines and a mission that genuinely matters. Fluency working in a fast, ambiguous, founding-team environment where you define the process as much as follow it. Bonus points for: mechanical / mechatronic breadth (you can reason about hulls, sealing, and thrust as well as circuits); experience with subsea or marine hardware; comms in degraded / contested environments; CFD or hydrodynamics intuition; or having taken a hardware product from zero to fielded at scale. Why join now Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that. A mission with weight. This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space. Real things, in the real ocean, fast. You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years. AI-first, at the edge, in the real world. We train our own models and run them where it counts: in the water, on the device. You'll be solving the edge-ML and power problems most companies only talk about. A sovereign, European deeptech at the inflection point of a market with strong NATO and EU policy momentum behind it.
